jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital world s . Siemens is a leading technology company ( employing around 6,000 people in Switzerland / 320,000 globally ). We provide pioneering solutions for the building technology, energy, mobility, healthcare, and industry sectors. Your new responsibilities
• Write your bachelor, master or doctoral thesis with one of the leading technology companies in the field of digitisation
• Combine theory and practice and get to know the company better
• Deepen your knowledge and lay the foundation for your professional career Your talents and experience
• Studies at a Swiss university of applied sciences or university in the fields of (business) informatics, (business) engineering or electrical engineering
• Quick comprehension, structured and independent working style and ability to work in a team
• Very good knowledge of German and English
• Start by agreement Who and where we are Find out why Siemens is chosen every year as one of the most popular employers in Switzerland, and get a first impression of a new working environment and the people who could be your new work colleagues. descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo il mondo reale e digitale s. Siemens è una società tecnologica leader (che impiega circa 6.000 persone in Svizzera / 320.000 a livello globale). Forniamo soluzioni pionieristiche per la tecnologia degli edifici, l'energia, la mobilità, la sanità e il settore industriale. Le nuove responsabilità
• Scrivi la tua tesi di laurea, master o dottorato con una delle principali aziende tecnologiche nel campo della digitalizzazione
• Combinare la teoria e la pratica e conoscere meglio l'azienda
• Approfondisci la tua conoscenza e getti le basi per la tua carriera professionale
• Studi presso un'università svizzera di scienze applicate o universitarie nei settori dell'informatica (business), dell'ingegneria o dell'ingegneria elettrica
• Rapida comprensione, stile di lavoro strutturato e indipendente e capacità di lavorare in un team
• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese
• Inizia con l'accordo Chi e dove siamo Scopri perché Siemens viene scelto ogni anno come uno dei datori di lavoro più popolari in Svizzera, e ottenere una prima impressione di un nuovo ambiente di lavoro e le persone che potrebbero essere i vostri nuovi colleghi di lavoro. Homepage Siemens come datore di lavoro non vedo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda. Isidora Talent Acquisizione

jobs.description:
Nous relions les mondes réels et numériques en collaboration avec nos clients. Siemens est un leader technologique qui emploie environ 6000 personnes. Technique du bâtiment, énergie, mobilité, santé et industrie : nos solutions innovantes portent sur de nombreux domaines et façonnent le monde de demain. En tant que technicien·ne de service senior, vous avez la possibilité d’être votre propre chef et de profiter d’une grande liberté dans la planification des interventions clients. Vous aimeriez aussi contribuer aux prochaines innovations et améliorer la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Déposez votre candidature dès aujourd’hui en tant que Technicien senior contrôle d’accès (f/h/d) et commence dès que possible – votre équipe se réjouisse de vous accueillir ! Lieu de travail : veuillez noter que nous recherchons deux technicien·nes senior en contrôle d’accès : l’un pour notre site de Plan-les-Ouates (GE) et l’autre pouvant être basé à St‑Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) ou Renens (VD). Pas de CV sous la main ? Aucun problème ! Avec nous, vous pouvez commencer votre candidature sur WhatsApp et nous contacter facilement et directement. Vos nouvelles tâches
• Former et accompagner les équipes techniques (préparer les supports, mise en service d’installations de contrôle d’accès)
• Accompagner les équipes de vente dans l’élaboration de concepts majeurs en phase pré-sales
• Contribuer à la maintenance, aux réparations, à l’entretien et au dépannage des installations (en assurant le service de piquet ainsi que le respect des directives de qualité et de sécurité au travail)
• Réaliser des proofs of concept sur les nouvelles technologies de sureté
• Effectuer les tâches administratives telles que rapports d’intervention, conformément aux processus de qualité et de sécurité
• Conseiller, assister et accompagner les clients tout au long de leurs projets Vos talents et votre expérience
• Formation technique : électricien·ne, automaticien·ne, télématicien·ne ou qualification équivalente
• Excellente maîtrise des systèmes de contrôle d’accès et des technologies associées (badges, biométrie, etc.)
• Solide compréhension des environnements informatiques et réseaux (serveurs, switches, etc.)
• Sens aigu de la qualité, orientation clients et résultats
• De nature enthousiaste, proactive et communicative
• Langue maternelle française, avec idéalement de bonnes connaissances d’une deuxième langue (allemand ou anglais) Vos avantages
• Votre propre voiture électrique (que vous pourrez également utiliser à titre privé)
• Travail indépendant et flexible, et liberté de planifier vos interventions
• Nombreuses opportunités de développement et de formation continue
• Formations continues rémunérées
• Retrouve tous les avantages ici Notre culture d’entreprise – ton nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est bien plus qu’un simple environnement de travail : elle est au cœur de notre collaboration quotidienne et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail tourné vers l’avenir, faisant la part belle à l’innovation, au développement durable et à l’épanouissement personnel. Nous nous distinguons par notre responsabilité individuelle, l’égalité des chances et la diversité, qui permettent à chaque collaborateur et collaboratrice de s’investir de manière authentique. Nous mettons en œuvre des modèles de travail flexibles et le travail mobile afin de permettre à notre personnel de trouver un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Retrouve plus d’informations et découvre avec notre quiz culture si vous convenez à Siemens ! « Siemens est synonyme de qualité, d’innovation et de durabilité! Je m’identifie pleinement à ces valeurs. » (Process Manager) Actualités et stories Découvre par vous-même à quel point les innovations technologiques peuvent déjà transformer notre vie. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur les projets qui peuvent être mis en œuvre à l’aide de la technologie Siemens, vous trouverez ici quelques exemples actuels . Questions fréquentes et votre interlocuteur ou interlocutrice Vous trouverez ici une synthèse des questions fréquemment posées ainsi que la possibilité de nous contacter directement. J’attends votre candidature avec impatience ! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Votre parcours vers Siemens - How we hire Information concernant le placement de personnel : pour ce poste, Siemens Suisse n’accepte pas les candidatures issues du placement de personnel. Merci de votre compréhension.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Connettiamo mondi reali e digitali in collaborazione con i nostri clienti. Siemens è un leader tecnologico che impiega circa 6.000 persone. Tecnologia costruttiva, energia, mobilità, salute e industria: le nostre soluzioni innovative abbracciano molti campi e plasmano il mondo di domani. Come tecnico di servizio senior, hai la possibilità di essere il tuo leader e godere di grande libertà nella pianificazione degli interventi dei clienti. Vorresti anche contribuire alle prossime innovazioni e migliorare la vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora questo post è per voi! Applicare oggi come Senior Access Control Technician (f/h/d) e iniziare il prima possibile – il vostro team è impaziente di accogliervi! Si prega di notare che stiamo cercando due tecnici senior di controllo accessi: uno per il nostro sito Plan-les-Ouates (GE) e l'altro che può essere basato in St-Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) o Renens (VD). Le nuove attività
• Formare e accompagnare i team tecnici (preparare i supporti, commissionare i controlli di accesso)
• Sostenere i team di vendita nello sviluppo di importanti concetti pre-vendita
• Contribuisci alla manutenzione, alla riparazione, alla manutenzione e alla risoluzione dei problemi delle strutture (fornendo il servizio picket e il rispetto delle linee guida di qualità e sicurezza sul lavoro)
• Prove di concetto sulle nuove tecnologie di sicurezza
• Eseguire i compiti amministrativi come i rapporti di intervento, in conformità ai processi di qualità e sicurezza
• Consigli, assistenza e assistenza ai clienti durante i loro progetti I tuoi talenti ed esperienza
• Formazione tecnica: elettricista, automatico, telematico o equivalente
• Ottimo controllo dei sistemi di controllo degli accessi e delle tecnologie associate (cattivi, biometrie, ecc.)
• Forte comprensione degli ambienti di computer e di rete (server, interruttori, ecc.)
• Alta qualità, orientamento del cliente e risultati
• Enthusiastic, proattivo e comunicativo
• Lingua madre francese, idealmente con buona conoscenza di una seconda lingua (tedesco o inglese)
• La tua auto elettrica (che puoi anche usare privatamente)
• Autooccupazione e flessibilità e libertà di pianificare i vostri interventi
• Molte opportunità di sviluppo e formazione
• Formazione continua pagata
• Trova tutti i vantaggi qui La nostra cultura aziendale – il tuo nuovo ambiente di lavoro La cultura di Siemens Svizzera è molto più di un semplice ambiente di lavoro: è al centro della nostra collaborazione quotidiana e della chiave del nostro successo. Siemens Svizzera offre un ambiente di lavoro all'avanguardia, con un focus sull'innovazione, lo sviluppo sostenibile e lo sviluppo personale. Ci distinguono per la nostra responsabilità individuale, l'uguaglianza di opportunità e la diversità, che permettono a ogni dipendente di investire in modo autentico. Realizziamo modelli di lavoro flessibili e lavoro mobile per consentire al nostro personale di bilanciare il lavoro e la privacy. Trova maggiori informazioni e scopri con la nostra cultura quiz se sei adatto per Siemens! " Siemens è sinonimo di qualità, innovazione e sostenibilità! Mi identifico pienamente con questi valori. » (Process Manager) Notizie e Storie Scoprite da soli come le innovazioni tecnologiche possono già trasformare la nostra vita. Se volete saperne di più sui progetti che possono essere implementati utilizzando la tecnologia Siemens, qui troverete alcuni esempi attuali. Domande frequenti e il tuo interlocutore Qui troverete un riassunto delle domande frequenti e la possibilità di contattarci direttamente. Non vedo l'ora della sua applicazione! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Il vostro viaggio a Siemens - Come assumere Informazioni sul posizionamento del personale: Siemens Svizzera non accetta applicazioni dal posizionamento del personale. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
We connect real and digital worlds in collaboration with our customers. Siemens is a technological leader who employs approximately 6,000 people. Building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry: our innovative solutions span many fields and shape the world of tomorrow. As a senior service technician, you have the opportunity to be your own leader and enjoy great freedom in the planning of client interventions. Would you also like to contribute to the next innovations and improve the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then this post is for you! Apply today as Senior Access Control Technician (f/h/d) and start as soon as possible – your team is looking forward to welcoming you! Please note that we are looking for two senior access control technicians: one for our Plan-les-Ouates (GE) site and the other which can be based in St-Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) or Renens (VD). Your new tasks
• Train and accompany technical teams (preparing supports, commissioning access control facilities)
• Support sales teams in the development of major pre-sales concepts
• Contribute to the maintenance, repair, maintenance and troubleshooting of facilities (by providing picket service and compliance with quality and safety guidelines at work)
• Making proofs of concept on new safety technologies
• Perform administrative tasks such as intervention reports, in accordance with quality and safety processes
• Advise, assist and support clients throughout their projects Your talents and experience
• Technical training: electrician, automatician, telematician or equivalent qualification
• Excellent control of access control systems and associated technologies (badges, biometrics, etc.)
• Strong understanding of computer and network environments (servers, switches, etc.)
• High quality, customer orientation and results
• Enthusiastic, proactive and communicative
• French mother tongue, ideally with good knowledge of a second language (German or English) Your Benefits
• Your own electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Self-employment and flexibility, and freedom to plan your interventions
• Many opportunities for development and further training
• Paid continuing training
• Find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment Siemens Switzerland's culture is much more than just a work environment: it is at the heart of our daily collaboration and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a forward-looking working environment, with a focus on innovation, sustainable development and personal development. We distinguish ourselves by our individual responsibility, equality of opportunity and diversity, which allow each employee to invest in a genuine way. We implement flexible work models and mobile work to allow our staff to balance work and privacy. Find more information and discover with our culture quiz if you are suitable for Siemens! " Siemens stands for quality, innovation and sustainability! I fully identify with these values. » (Process Manager) News and Stories Discover for yourself how technological innovations can already transform our lives. If you want to know more about the projects that can be implemented using Siemens technology, here you will find some current examples. Frequently asked questions and your interlocutor Here you will find a summary of frequently asked questions and the possibility to contact us directly. I'm looking forward to your application! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Your journey to Siemens - How we hire Information on the placement of staff: Siemens Switzerland does not accept applications from the placement of staff. Thank you for your understanding.

Wir verbinden reale und digitale Welten in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Siemens ist Technologieführer und beschäftigt rund 6.000 Mitarbeiter. Gebäudetechnik, Energie, Mobilität, Gesundheit und Industrie: Unsere innovativen Lösungen umfassen viele Bereiche und prägen die Welt von morgen. Als Senior Service Techniker haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre eigene Führungskraft zu sein und genießen große Freiheit bei der Planung von Kundeninterventionen. Möchten Sie auch zu den nächsten Innovationen beitragen und das Leben von Millionen Menschen in der Schweiz verbessern? Dieser Post ist für dich! Bewerben Sie sich noch heute als Senior Access Control Techniker (w/h/d) und starten Sie so schnell wie möglich – Ihr Team freut sich auf Sie! Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir zwei leitende Zugangskontrolltechniker suchen: einen für unseren Plan-les-Ouates (GE) Standort und den anderen, der in St-Blaise (NE), Corminboeuf (FR) oder Renens (VD) ansässig sein kann. Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Trainieren und begleiten Sie technische Teams (Vorbereitung von Unterstützung, Inbetriebnahme von Zugangskontrolleinrichtungen)
• Unterstützung von Vertriebsteams bei der Entwicklung wichtiger Pre-Sales-Konzepte
• Beitrag zur Wartung, Reparatur, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung von Einrichtungen (durch Bereitstellung von Streikposten und Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien bei der Arbeit)
• Mache Machbarkeitsnachweise für neue Sicherheitstechnologien
• Führen Sie administrative Aufgaben wie Interventionsberichte in Übereinstimmung mit Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsprozessen durch
• Beratung, Unterstützung und Unterstützung von Kunden während ihrer Projekte Ihre Talente und Erfahrungen
• Technische Ausbildung: Elektriker, Automatiker, Telematiker oder gleichwertige Qualifikation
• Hervorragende Kontrolle von Zugangskontrollsystemen und zugehörigen Technologien (Badges, Biometrie usw.)
• Starkes Verständnis von Computer- und Netzwerkumgebungen (Server, Switches usw.)
• Hohe Qualität, Kundenorientierung und Ergebnisse
• Enthusiatisch, proaktiv und kommunikativ
• Französische Muttersprache, idealerweise mit guten Kenntnissen einer zweiten Sprache (Deutsch oder Englisch) Ihre Vorteile
• Ihr eigenes Elektroauto (das Sie auch privat nutzen können)
• Selbständigkeit und Flexibilität und die Freiheit, Ihre Interventionen zu planen
• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und Weiterbildung
• Bezahlte Weiterbildung
• Alle Vorteile finden Sie hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur – Ihre neue Arbeitswelt Die Kultur von Siemens Schweiz ist viel mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld: Sie steht im Mittelpunkt unserer täglichen Zusammenarbeit und ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsweisendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Fokus auf Innovation, nachhaltige Entwicklung und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir zeichnen uns durch unsere individuelle Verantwortung, Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt aus, die es jedem Mitarbeiter ermöglichen, wirklich zu investieren. Wir implementieren flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobile Arbeit, damit unsere Mitarbeiter Arbeit und Privatsphäre in Einklang bringen können. Erfahren Sie mehr und entdecken Sie mit unserem Kulturquiz, ob Sie für Siemens geeignet sind! Siemens steht für Qualität, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit! Ich identifiziere mich voll und ganz mit diesen Werten. » (Process Manager) News and Stories Entdecken Sie selbst, wie technologische Innovationen bereits unser Leben verändern können. Wenn Sie mehr darüber erfahren möchten, welche Projekte mit Siemens-Technologie umgesetzt werden können, finden Sie hier einige aktuelle Beispiele. Häufig gestellte Fragen und Ihr Gesprächspartner Hier finden Sie eine Zusammenfassung der häufig gestellten Fragen und die Möglichkeit, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Ich freue mich auf Ihre Bewerbung! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Ihre Reise zu Siemens - So stellen wir Informationen zur Personalvermittlung ein: Siemens Schweiz nimmt keine Bewerbungen aus der Personalvermittlung an. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen nach Menschen, die mit uns die Digitalisierung von Morgen gestalten. Denn – Wir machen digital. Willkommen bei Siemens Digital Industries Software. Wir sind ein dynamisches Softwareunternehmen, das beständig wächst und unseren Kunden bereits heute die Technologien und Innovationen von morgen liefert. Durch die Stärken eines Unternehmens wie Siemens sind Deine Möglichkeiten grenzenlos. Die Siemens Digital Industries Software ist die Software-Säule von Siemens. Wir begeistern, unterstützen und beraten unsere Kund*innen in jeglichen Fragestellungen rund um das Thema Software – mit Fokus auf die unterschiedlichen Industriezweige. Mit dem weltweit umfangreichsten Portfolio im Bereich Industriesoftware gestalten wir die Digitalisierung von morgen! Hast Du Lust anzupacken, Dinge neu zu denken und direkt am Herzen der digitalen Transformation zu arbeiten? Dann bewirb Dich und starte Deine Zukunft mit uns – als Sales Executive gestaltest Du Innovation aktiv mit. Welche Rolle wirst Du spielen? In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du aktiv den Ausbau unseres Software-Geschäfts bei Kunden aus dem Bereich Pharma & CPG. Unser Ziel ist es, den Kunden durch innovative, digitale Lösungen nachhaltig zu begeistern – und das erreichen wir gemeinsam, agil und mit klarem Fokus auf Mehrwert.
• Du analysierst den Markt systematisch, beobachtest technologische Trends und entwickelst daraus konkrete Ansätze zur Erweiterung unseres Kundenportfolios
• Auf Basis dieser Erkenntnisse entwickelst Du kundenindividuelle, global ausgerichtete Vertriebsstrategien und bringst neue, zukunftsweisende Lösungen aus unserem stetig wachsenden Portfolio in die bestehende Systemlandschaft des Kunden ein
• Du agierst als kompetenter Ansprechpartner*in auf allen Ebenen – auch auf C-Level – und vertrittst unsere Themen mit Klarheit, Überzeugung und unternehmerischem Gespür
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kunden und unseren interdisziplinären Teams entwickelst Du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für Engineering- und Produktionsumgebungen, einschließlich aller relevanten Domänen
• Du führst den Kunden durch den gesamten Entscheidungsprozess, stellst den konkreten Nutzen verständlich dar und treibst Projekte mit der nötigen Beharrlichkeit bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss
• Im gesamten Sales-Zyklus übernimmst Du die Rolle des Orchestrators: Du koordinierst alle internen und externen Beteiligten – von PreSales über Service bis hin zu R&D – und sorgst dafür, dass wir als starkes, agiles Team auftreten Wie wirst Du Teil unseres Teams? Mit Leidenschaft und Mut!
• Du brennst für gute Ideen: Als kreative, engagierte Persönlichkeit denkst Du unternehmerisch, schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und findest für jede Herausforderung eine smarte Lösung
• Du kannst Menschen gewinnen: Mit Fingerspitzengefühl und Überzeugungskraft baust Du tragfähige Beziehungen auf – besonders auf C-Level wirst Du als Partner auf Augenhöhe geschätzt
• Du bist ein Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne im Schulterschluss mit Kolleg*innen aus Vertrieb, PreSales, Service und Entwicklung mit der Überzeugung, dass wir nur gemeinsam erfolgreich sind
• Du kennst das Geschäft : Deine mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb von Softwarelösungen gibt Dir Sicherheit bei Verhandlungen
• Du sprichst die Sprache der Branche: Mit fundiertem Wissen zu Prozessen und Anwendungen der Industrien – vom ersten Entwicklungsschritt bis zur fertigen Produktion – trittst Du souverän auf.
• Du bist sprachlich fit: Wir verstehen unsere Kunden auf Deutsch und Englisch Bist du ein*e Ideengestalter*in? Dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams! Wenn du erste Fragen mit unserem Recruiting Team klären möchtest, wende Dich gerne per Mail an: globaldiswcandidateexperience.ie@siemens.com. Aufgrund der Datenschutzbestimmungen (GDPR) können wir keine Lebensläufe per E-Mail annehmen. Bitte reiche Deine Bewerbung über unser Karriere-Portal ein. Ansprechperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Markus Kies. Du möchtest vor Deiner Bewerbung mehr über Siemens Digital Industries Software erfahren? Mission / Vision und unser Software Portfolio – oder besuche unsere Homepage. Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit für alle Menschen. Insbesondere möchten wir Menschen mit Behinderung ermutigen, sich zu bewerben. Pay Transparency Die Gesamtvergütung für diese Position liegt im Bereich von CHF 171.00 bis CHF 300.800, wobei 40% davon aus einem jährlichen Anreizziel (100% Erreichung) bestehen. Die tatsächlich angebotene Vergütung basiert auf den jobspezifischen Fähigkeiten, der Erfahrung und der relevanten Ausbildung/Schulung des erfolgreichen Kandidaten. Siemens bietet Gesundheits- und Wellnessleistungen für Mitarbeiter an; Sie können auf die in Ihrem Land verfügbaren Leistungen über den folgenden Link zugreifen: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando persone che formeranno la digitalizzazione di domani con noi. Perché – facciamo digitale. Benvenuti al software Siemens Digital Industries. Siamo una società di software dinamica che cresce costantemente e già oggi offre le tecnologie e le innovazioni di domani ai nostri clienti. Con i punti di forza di un'azienda come Siemens, le tue possibilità sono infinite. Siemens Digital Industries Il software è il pilastro software di Siemens. Ispiriamo, supportiamo e consigliamo ai nostri clienti su qualsiasi problema software – con un focus sulle diverse industrie. Con il portafoglio software industriale più completo al mondo, stiamo plasmando la digitalizzazione di domani! Vuoi affrontare, ripensare le cose e lavorare direttamente al cuore della trasformazione digitale? Poi applica e inizia il tuo futuro con noi – come Sales Executive fornisci attivamente innovazione. Quale ruolo giocherai? In questo ruolo, si forma attivamente l'espansione del nostro business software con i clienti del settore Pharma & CPG. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di ispirare il cliente in modo sostenibile attraverso soluzioni innovative e digitali – e lo raggiungeremo insieme, agile e con una chiara attenzione al valore aggiunto.
• Analizzi sistematicamente il mercato, osservi le tendenze tecnologiche e sviluppi approcci concreti per espandere il nostro portafoglio clienti.
• Sulla base di questi risultati, svilupperai strategie di vendita orientate a livello globale e porterai nuove soluzioni orientate al futuro dal nostro portafoglio in costante crescita nel panorama del sistema esistente del cliente.
• Lei agisce come una persona di contatto competente a tutti i livelli – anche a livello C – e rappresenta i nostri argomenti con chiarezza, convinzione e senso imprenditoriale
• Sviluppato in stretta collaborazione con il cliente e i nostri team interdisciplinari Soluzioni personalizzate per l'ingegneria e gli ambienti produttivi, compresi tutti i domini rilevanti
• Guidare il cliente attraverso l'intero processo decisionale, comprendere i vantaggi concreti e guidare i progetti con la necessaria persistenza fino al completamento di successo
• Assumere l'intero ciclo di vendita Si gioca il ruolo dell'orchestra: si coordina tutti gli stakeholder interni ed esterni – dalla pre-vendita al servizio alla R&D – e assicurarsi di agire come un team forte e agile. Come fai a diventare parte della nostra squadra? Con passione e coraggio!
• Bruciate per buone idee: Come personalità creativa, impegnata, si pensa imprenditoriale, guardare al di fuori della scatola e trovare una soluzione intelligente per ogni sfida.
• Puoi vincere le persone: costruire con sensibilità e persuasione Si diventa un rapporto sostenibile – soprattutto a livello C Siete apprezzati come partner a livello degli occhi
• Sei un giocatore di squadra: Vi piace lavorare insieme a colleghi di vendite, pre-vendita, servizio e sviluppo con la convinzione che abbiamo solo successo insieme
• Conosci l'azienda: la tua pluriennale esperienza nella vendita di soluzioni software Essere al sicuro nei negoziati
• Parli il linguaggio del settore: Con una conoscenza approfondita dei processi e delle applicazioni delle industrie – dal primo passo di sviluppo alla produzione finita – sei sicuro.
• Sei linguisticamente in forma: Comprendiamo i nostri clienti in tedesco e inglese Sei un idea designer? Diventa subito parte della nostra squadra! Se volete chiarire le domande iniziali con il nostro team di reclutamento, vi preghiamo di contattarci via e-mail: globaldiswcandidateexperience.ie@siemens.com. A causa della normativa sulla protezione dei dati (GDPR), non possiamo accettare CV via e-mail. Invia la tua candidatura tramite il nostro portale di carriera. La persona di contatto per questa pubblicità di lavoro è Markus Kies. Vuoi saperne di più su Siemens Digital Industries Software prima di applicare? Mission / Vision e il nostro portafoglio software – o visitare la nostra homepage. Apprezziamo le pari opportunità per tutte le persone. In particolare, vorremmo incoraggiare le persone con disabilità ad applicare. Il compenso totale di questa posizione è nell'intervallo di CHF 171.00 a CHF 300.800, il 40% dei quali è costituito da un obiettivo di incentivazione annuale (100% di realizzazione). L'effettivo compenso offerto si basa sulle competenze, sull'esperienza e sulla formazione/formazione del candidato di successo. Siemens offre servizi di salute e benessere per i dipendenti; Potete accedere ai servizi disponibili nel vostro paese tramite il seguente link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for people who will shape the digitalization of tomorrow with us. Because – we make digital. Welcome to Siemens Digital Industries Software. We are a dynamic software company that is constantly growing and already today delivers the technologies and innovations of tomorrow to our customers. With the strengths of a company like Siemens, your possibilities are limitless. Siemens Digital Industries Software is the software pillar of Siemens. We inspire, support and advise our customers on any software issue – with a focus on the different industries. With the world’s most comprehensive industrial software portfolio, we are shaping the digitalization of tomorrow! Do you want to tackle, rethink things and work directly at the heart of the digital transformation? Then apply and start your future with us – as Sales Executive you actively shape innovation. What role will you play? In this role, you actively shape the expansion of our software business with customers from the Pharma & CPG sector. Our goal is to inspire the customer sustainably through innovative, digital solutions – and we achieve this together, agile and with a clear focus on added value.
• You analyze the market systematically, observe technological trends and develop concrete approaches to expand our customer portfolio.
• Based on these findings, you will develop customer-specific, globally oriented sales strategies and bring new, future-oriented solutions from our constantly growing portfolio into the customer’s existing system landscape.
• You act as a competent contact person at all levels – also at C-level – and represent our topics with clarity, conviction and entrepreneurial sense
• Developed in close cooperation with the customer and our interdisciplinary teams Customized solutions for engineering and production environments, including all relevant domains
• You guide the customer through the entire decision-making process, understand the concrete benefits and drive projects with the necessary persistence until successful completion
• Take over the entire sales cycle You play the role of orchestra: you coordinate all internal and external stakeholders – from pre-sales to service to R&D – and ensure that we act as a strong, agile team. How do you become part of our team? With passion and courage!
• You burn for good ideas: As a creative, committed personality, you think entrepreneurially, look outside the box and find a smart solution for every challenge.
• You can win people: Building with sensitivity and persuasion You become a sustainable relationship – especially at C-level You are valued as a partner at eye level
• You are a team player: You enjoy working together with colleagues from sales, pre-sales, service and development with the conviction that we are only successful together
• You know the business : your several years of experience in the sales of software solutions Being safe in negotiations
• You speak the language of the industry: With in-depth knowledge of the processes and applications of the industries – from the first development step to the finished production – you are confident.
• You are linguistically fit: We understand our customers in German and English Are you an idea designer? Become part of our team now! If you would like to clarify initial questions with our recruiting team, please contact us by email: globaldiswcandidateexperience.ie@siemens.com. Due to the data protection regulations (GDPR), we cannot accept CVs by e-mail. Please submit your application via our career portal. The contact person for this job advertisement is Markus Kies. Would you like to know more about Siemens Digital Industries Software before applying? Mission / Vision and our software portfolio – or visit our homepage. We value equal opportunities for all people. In particular, we would like to encourage people with disabilities to apply. The total compensation for this position is in the range of CHF 171.00 to CHF 300.800, 40% of which consists of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the job-specific skills, experience and relevant education/training of the successful candidate. Siemens offers health and wellness services for employees; You can access the services available in your country via the following link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous cherchons des gens qui façonneront la numérisation de demain avec nous. Parce que – nous faisons numérique. Bienvenue dans Siemens Digital Industries Software. Nous sommes une entreprise de logiciel dynamique qui est en constante croissance et déjà aujourd'hui fournit les technologies et les innovations de demain à nos clients. Avec les forces d'une entreprise comme Siemens, vos possibilités sont illimitées. Siemens Industries numériques Le logiciel est le pilier logiciel de Siemens. Nous inspirons, soutenons et conseillons nos clients sur tout problème de logiciel – en mettant l'accent sur les différentes industries. Avec le portefeuille de logiciels industriels le plus complet du monde, nous façonnons la numérisation de demain ! Voulez-vous aborder, repenser les choses et travailler directement au cœur de la transformation numérique ? Alors appliquez et commencez votre avenir avec nous – en tant que Sales Executive, vous façonnez activement l'innovation. Quel rôle allez-vous jouer ? Dans ce rôle, vous façonnez activement l'expansion de notre activité logicielle avec des clients du secteur Pharma & CPG. Notre objectif est d'inspirer durablement le client à travers des solutions numériques innovantes – et nous y parvenons ensemble, agiles et en mettant clairement l'accent sur la valeur ajoutée.
• Vous analysez systématiquement le marché, observez les tendances technologiques et développez des approches concrètes pour élargir notre portefeuille de clients.
• Sur la base de ces résultats, vous développerez des stratégies de vente spécifiques au client et orientées vers le monde entier et apporterez de nouvelles solutions orientées vers l'avenir de notre portefeuille en constante croissance dans le paysage système existant du client.
• Vous agissez comme une personne de contact compétente à tous les niveaux – aussi au niveau C – et représentez nos sujets avec clarté, conviction et sens entrepreneurial
• Développé en étroite collaboration avec le client et nos équipes interdisciplinaires Solutions personnalisées pour les environnements d'ingénierie et de production, y compris tous les domaines pertinents
• Vous guidez le client tout au long du processus de prise de décision, comprenez les avantages concrets et conduisez les projets avec la persévérance nécessaire jusqu'à la réussite
• Prenez le contrôle de tout le cycle des ventes Vous jouez le rôle d'orchestre : vous coordonnez tous les intervenants internes et externes – de la prévente au service à la R-D – et vous assurez que nous agissons comme une équipe forte et agile. Comment faites-vous partie de notre équipe ? Avec passion et courage !
• Vous brûlez pour de bonnes idées: En tant que personnalité créative et engagée, vous pensez entrepreneurialement, regardez en dehors de la boîte et trouvez une solution intelligente pour chaque défi.
• Vous pouvez gagner les gens : construire avec sensibilité et persuasion Vous devenez une relation durable – en particulier au niveau C Vous êtes apprécié comme partenaire au niveau des yeux
• Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe: Vous aimez travailler avec des collègues de la vente, pré-vente, service et développement avec la conviction que nous ne sommes que le succès ensemble
• Vous connaissez l'entreprise : vos nombreuses années d'expérience dans la vente de solutions logicielles Être sûr dans les négociations
• Vous parlez la langue de l'industrie: Avec une connaissance approfondie des processus et des applications de l'industrie – de la première étape de développement à la production finie – vous êtes confiant.
• Vous êtes linguistiquement en forme: Nous comprenons nos clients en allemand et en anglais Êtes-vous un concepteur d'idées? Faites partie de notre équipe maintenant ! Si vous souhaitez clarifier les questions initiales avec notre équipe de recrutement, veuillez nous contacter par email: globaldiswcandidateexpériment.ie@siemens.com. En raison de la réglementation sur la protection des données (RGPD), nous ne pouvons pas accepter les CV par courriel. Veuillez soumettre votre candidature via notre portail carrière. La personne-ressource pour cette annonce d'emploi est Markus Kies. Vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur Siemens Digital Industries Software avant de postuler ? Mission / Vision et notre portfolio logiciel – ou visitez notre page d'accueil. Nous apprécions l'égalité des chances pour tous. En particulier, nous voudrions encourager les personnes handicapées à présenter une demande. La rémunération totale pour ce poste se situe entre CHF 171.00 et CHF 300.800, dont 40% sont constitués par un objectif incitatif annuel (100% de réalisation). La rémunération réelle offerte est fondée sur les compétences, l'expérience et la formation pertinentes du candidat reçu. Siemens offre des services de santé et de bien-être aux employés; Vous pouvez accéder aux services disponibles dans votre pays via le lien suivant: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/bénéfices/

jobs.description:
Youtube Video Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. We are looking for a motivated colleague as Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems for our global Buildings Business Unit. In this role you are responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high‑quality technical training programs related to Siemens’ fire detection and safety systems. You translate complex technical, regulatory, and system-related topics into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences for internal employees, customers, and partners. You combine deep technical expertise with strong didactic skills and collaborate closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure training content is aligned with product developments, regulatory requirements, and customer needs. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Location : this position will be based in Zug/Switzerland. Prerequisite is your legal eligibility to work in Switzerland. Your new responsibilities
• Training Program Development: Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive technical training concepts and curricula for fire safety systems and solutions, translating complex regulations and architectures into practical, learner-focused content for various target groups (Technical Engineers, Technical Technicians, Project Managers, Technical Support, and End Users)
• Training Delivery & Facilitation: Plan, organize, and conduct engaging technical fire safety trainings in diverse formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid), facilitating both theoretical sessions and practical, system-based exercises for all skill levels
• Learning Content Creation & Management: Develop, update, and manage high-quality learning assets, including documentation, presentations, manuals, exercises, and digital content (e.g., e-learning, videos), ensuring alignment with current regulations and product releases
• Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Collaborate closely with internal teams (Product Management, R&D, Technical support, ) to align training content with product updates, regulatory changes, and customer requirements
• Quality Assurance & Continuous Learning: Collect participant feedback to continuously improve training quality, actively supporting knowledge transfer and fostering a culture of continuous learning within the organization
• Special Projects & Mentoring: Support or lead certification/approval programs, contribute to global/regional training initiatives, and coach/mentor subject matter experts and junior trainers Your skills and experience
• Technical degree in electrical engineering, fire safety, building technologies, or a related field
• Proven experience with fire detection or safety systems, coupled with a strong understanding of relevant regulations, standards, and system architectures (certification is a plus)
• Demonstrated experience in technical training, knowledge transfer, or a comparable role, ideally including familiarity with digital learning formats and e-learning tools
• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear, practical, and engaging content for diverse audiences
• Structured, self-organized, and quality-oriented working style, comfortable with various learning formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid)
• Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder management skills, ideally gained within an international or matrix organization
• Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in German is a significant advantage What We Offer
• A challenging and impactful role at the cutting edge of fire safety technology
• High level of responsibility and autonomy in shaping technical training
• Close collaboration with experts across engineering, product development, and project teams
• Opportunities to drive global training concepts and foster continuous improvement
• Dedicated support for your professional development and continuous learning
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here What it’s like working for us We place significant emphasis on fostering an inclusive and flexible working culture that encourages everyone to be their authentic selves. Equal opportunities and diversity are important to us and contribute to an enriching culture. We actively embrace mobile working to provide every colleague with more autonomy and the chance to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more here News and stories See for yourself how innovative technology can change the present. If you want to find out more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly I look forward to receiving your application Carmen Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens does not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Video di Youtube Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo i mondi reali e digitali Con tecnologia, software e servizi per edifici intelligenti, trasformiamo il quotidiano per tutti. Combinando i mondi reali e digitali, possiamo permettere ai nostri clienti di raggiungere i loro obiettivi di decarbonizzazione, abbassare i costi operativi e creare esperienze occupanti di livello mondiale per la loro gente. Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. Stiamo cercando un collega motivato come Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems per la nostra Global Buildings Business Unit. In questo ruolo sei responsabile della progettazione, della fornitura e del miglioramento continuo dei programmi di formazione tecnica di alta qualità relativi ai sistemi di rilevamento e sicurezza antincendio di Siemens. Traduci argomenti tecnici, normativi e legati al sistema in esperienze di apprendimento chiare, pratiche e coinvolgenti per dipendenti, clienti e partner interni. Combinate competenze tecniche profonde con forti competenze didattiche e collaborate a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire che i contenuti di formazione siano allineati agli sviluppi dei prodotti, ai requisiti normativi e alle esigenze dei clienti. Il nostro viaggio condiviso potrebbe portarti da qualche parte... dove vorresti andare? Posizione: questa posizione si baserà in Zug/Svizzera. Prerequisito è l'ammissibilità legale di lavorare in Svizzera. Le nuove responsabilità
• Sviluppo del programma di formazione: progettazione, sviluppo e mantenimento di concetti di formazione tecnica e curricula completi per sistemi e soluzioni di sicurezza antincendio, traducendo complesse normative e architetture in contenuti pratici e mirati agli studenti per vari gruppi target (Ingegneri tecnici, Tecnici tecnici, Project Manager, Supporto tecnico e Utenti finali)
• Training Delivery & Facilitation: Pianificare, organizzare e condurre allenamenti tecnici di sicurezza antincendio in diversi formati (classe, virtuale, ibrido), facilitando sia sessioni teoriche che esercitazioni pratiche, basate sul sistema per tutti i livelli di abilità
• Creazione e gestione dei contenuti di apprendimento: sviluppare, aggiornare e gestire attività di apprendimento di alta qualità, tra cui documentazione, presentazioni, manuali, esercizi e contenuti digitali (ad esempio, e-learning, video), assicurando l'allineamento con le normative attuali e le versioni dei prodotti
• Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team interni (Product Management, R&D, Supporto tecnico, ) per allineare i contenuti formativi con gli aggiornamenti dei prodotti, i cambiamenti normativi e i requisiti dei clienti
• Quality Assurance & Continuous Learning: Raccogliere feedback dei partecipanti per migliorare continuamente la qualità della formazione, sostenere attivamente il trasferimento della conoscenza e promuovere una cultura dell'apprendimento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione
• Progetti speciali & Mentoring: Sostegno o lead programmi di certificazione/approvazione, contribuire a iniziative di formazione globale/regionale, e coach/mentor soggetti esperti e formatori junior Le tue competenze ed esperienza
• Laurea tecnica in ingegneria elettrica, sicurezza antincendio, tecnologie per l'edilizia, o un campo correlato
• Esperienza comprovata con sistemi antincendio o di sicurezza, accoppiata con una forte comprensione delle normative, degli standard e delle architetture di sistema (la certificazione è un plus)
• Esperienza dimostrata nella formazione tecnica, nel trasferimento di conoscenze o in un ruolo paragonabile, tra cui la familiarità con i formati di apprendimento digitale e gli strumenti di e-learning
• Ottima presentazione, facilitazione e capacità comunicative, con la capacità di tradurre argomenti tecnici complessi in contenuti chiari, pratici e coinvolgenti per un pubblico diverso
• Stile di lavoro strutturato, auto-organizzato e orientato alla qualità, confortevole con vari formati di apprendimento (classe, virtuale, ibrido)
• Mindset collaborativo e forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, idealmente guadagnati all'interno di un'organizzazione internazionale o matrice
• Fluency in English è essenziale; la competenza in tedesco è un vantaggio significativo Che cosa offriamo
• Un ruolo impegnativo e d'impatto all'avanguardia della tecnologia antincendio
• Alto livello di responsabilità e autonomia nella formazione tecnica
• stretta collaborazione con esperti in ingegneria, sviluppo di prodotti e team di progetto
• Opportunità di guidare concetti di formazione globale e favorire il miglioramento continuo
• Supporto dedicato per lo sviluppo professionale e l'apprendimento continuo
• Ulteriori informazioni sulle prestazioni dei dipendenti possono essere trovate qui Che cosa è come lavorare per noi Mettiamo un'enfasi significativa sulla promozione di una cultura di lavoro inclusiva e flessibile che incoraggia tutti ad essere loro stessi autentici. Le pari opportunità e la diversità sono importanti per noi e contribuiscono ad una cultura arricchente. Abbracciamo attivamente il lavoro mobile per fornire ad ogni collega maggiore autonomia e la possibilità di raggiungere un buon equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. Scopri di più qui Notizie e storie Scopri come la tecnologia innovativa può cambiare il presente. Se volete saperne di più su quali progetti possono essere implementati utilizzando la tecnologia Siemens, ecco alcuni esempi attuali Domande frequenti e informazioni di contatto Qui troverete una raccolta di domande frequenti e un modo per contattarci direttamente non vedo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione Carmen Talent Acquisition Partner La vostra strada per Siemens - Come assumere Informazioni per le agenzie di reclutamento: Siemens non accetta richieste da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Youtube Video Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. We are looking for a motivated colleague as Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems for our global Buildings Business Unit. In this role you are responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously improving high‑quality technical training programs related to Siemens’ fire detection and safety systems. You translate complex technical, regulatory, and system-related topics into clear, practical, and engaging learning experiences for internal employees, customers, and partners. You combine deep technical expertise with strong didactic skills and collaborate closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure training content is aligned with product developments, regulatory requirements, and customer needs. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Location : this position will be based in Zug/Switzerland. Prerequisite is your legal eligibility to work in Switzerland. Your new responsibilities
• Training Program Development: Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive technical training concepts and curricula for fire safety systems and solutions, translating complex regulations and architectures into practical, learner-focused content for various target groups (Technical Engineers, Technical Technicians, Project Managers, Technical Support, and End Users)
• Training Delivery & Facilitation: Plan, organize, and conduct engaging technical fire safety trainings in diverse formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid), facilitating both theoretical sessions and practical, system-based exercises for all skill levels
• Learning Content Creation & Management: Develop, update, and manage high-quality learning assets, including documentation, presentations, manuals, exercises, and digital content (e.g., e-learning, videos), ensuring alignment with current regulations and product releases
• Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Collaborate closely with internal teams (Product Management, R&D, Technical support, ) to align training content with product updates, regulatory changes, and customer requirements
• Quality Assurance & Continuous Learning: Collect participant feedback to continuously improve training quality, actively supporting knowledge transfer and fostering a culture of continuous learning within the organization
• Special Projects & Mentoring: Support or lead certification/approval programs, contribute to global/regional training initiatives, and coach/mentor subject matter experts and junior trainers Your skills and experience
• Technical degree in electrical engineering, fire safety, building technologies, or a related field
• Proven experience with fire detection or safety systems, coupled with a strong understanding of relevant regulations, standards, and system architectures (certification is a plus)
• Demonstrated experience in technical training, knowledge transfer, or a comparable role, ideally including familiarity with digital learning formats and e-learning tools
• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear, practical, and engaging content for diverse audiences
• Structured, self-organized, and quality-oriented working style, comfortable with various learning formats (classroom, virtual, hybrid)
• Collaborative mindset and strong stakeholder management skills, ideally gained within an international or matrix organization
• Fluency in English is essential; proficiency in German is a significant advantage What We Offer
• A challenging and impactful role at the cutting edge of fire safety technology
• High level of responsibility and autonomy in shaping technical training
• Close collaboration with experts across engineering, product development, and project teams
• Opportunities to drive global training concepts and foster continuous improvement
• Dedicated support for your professional development and continuous learning
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here What it’s like working for us We place significant emphasis on fostering an inclusive and flexible working culture that encourages everyone to be their authentic selves. Equal opportunities and diversity are important to us and contribute to an enriching culture. We actively embrace mobile working to provide every colleague with more autonomy and the chance to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more here News and stories See for yourself how innovative technology can change the present. If you want to find out more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly I look forward to receiving your application Carmen Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens does not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

Youtube Video Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden verbinden wir die reale und digitale Welt Mit Technologie, Software und Services für intelligente Gebäude verwandeln wir den Alltag für alle. Durch die Kombination der realen und digitalen Welten befähigen wir unsere Kunden, ihre Dekarbonisierungsziele zu erreichen, ihre Betriebskosten zu senken und erstklassige Insassenerlebnisse für ihre Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Es geht nicht nur darum, Gebäude zu verbessern – es geht darum, effiziente, sichere, anpassungsfähige und nachhaltige Umgebungen zu schaffen, die die Art und Weise, wie die Welt lebt und arbeitet, verbessern. Die digitale Transformation von Gebäuden ist ein sich schnell verändernder, dynamischer Sektor, und er braucht mehr als nur großartige Technologie - er braucht auch großartige Menschen. Wir wissen, dass ein Unternehmen nur dann gedeiht, wenn seine Mitarbeiter florieren, also haben wir bei Siemens unsere Mitarbeiter an die erste Stelle gesetzt. Wir suchen einen motivierten Kollegen als Technical Trainer Brandschutzsysteme für unsere globale Business Unit Gebäude. In dieser Funktion sind Sie für die Konzeption, Bereitstellung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung hochwertiger technischer Schulungsprogramme im Zusammenhang mit den Brandmelde- und Sicherheitssystemen von Siemens verantwortlich. Sie übersetzen komplexe technische, regulatorische und systembezogene Themen in klare, praktische und ansprechende Lernerfahrungen für interne Mitarbeiter, Kunden und Partner. Sie kombinieren fundiertes technisches Know-how mit starken didaktischen Fähigkeiten und arbeiten eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Schulungsinhalte an Produktentwicklungen, regulatorischen Anforderungen und Kundenbedürfnissen ausgerichtet sind. Unsere gemeinsame Reise könnte dich überall hinbringen ... wohin würdest du gerne gehen? Standort : Diese Position wird in Zug/Schweiz ansässig sein. Voraussetzung ist Ihre gesetzliche Berechtigung, in der Schweiz zu arbeiten. Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Entwicklung von Schulungsprogrammen: Konzeption, Entwicklung und Pflege umfassender technischer Schulungskonzepte und Curricula für Brandschutzsysteme und -lösungen, Umsetzung komplexer Vorschriften und Architekturen in praktische, lernorientierte Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen (Techniker, Techniker, Projektmanager, technischer Support und Endbenutzer)
• Training Delivery & Facilitation: Planen, organisieren und führen Sie ansprechende technische Brandschutztrainings in verschiedenen Formaten (Klassenzimmer, virtuell, hybrid) durch und erleichtern sowohl theoretische Sitzungen als auch praktische, systembasierte Übungen für alle Qualifikationsniveaus
• Learning Content Creation & Management: Entwickeln, aktualisieren und verwalten Sie hochwertige Lernressourcen, einschließlich Dokumentation, Präsentationen, Handbücher, Übungen und digitale Inhalte (z. B. E-Learning, Videos), um die Übereinstimmung mit aktuellen Vorschriften und Produktfreigaben zu gewährleisten
• Stakeholder Collaboration & Alignment: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (Produktmanagement, R&D, Technischer Support, ) zur Anpassung der Schulungsinhalte an Produktupdates, regulatorische Änderungen und Kundenanforderungen
• Qualitätssicherung und kontinuierliches Lernen: Sammeln von Teilnehmerfeedback, um die Trainingsqualität kontinuierlich zu verbessern, den Wissenstransfer aktiv zu unterstützen und eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens innerhalb der Organisation zu fördern
• Spezielle Projekte & Mentoring: Unterstützung oder Leitung von Zertifizierungs-/Genehmigungsprogrammen, Beitrag zu globalen/regionalen Schulungsinitiativen sowie Coach/Mentor-Experten und Junior-Trainer Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
• Technischer Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Brandschutz, Gebäudetechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Bewährte Erfahrung mit Brandmelde- oder Sicherheitssystemen, gepaart mit einem starken Verständnis der relevanten Vorschriften, Normen und Systemarchitekturen (Zertifizierung ist ein Plus)
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der technischen Ausbildung, Wissenstransfer oder eine vergleichbare Rolle, idealerweise einschließlich Vertrautheit mit digitalen Lernformaten und E-Learning-Tools
• Hervorragende Präsentations-, Erleichterungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen in klare, praktische und ansprechende Inhalte für verschiedene Zielgruppen zu übersetzen
• Strukturierter, selbstorganisierter und qualitätsorientierter Arbeitsstil, komfortabel mit verschiedenen Lernformaten (Klassenzimmer, virtuell, hybrid)
• Kollaborative Denkweise und starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management, idealerweise innerhalb einer internationalen oder Matrix-Organisation erworben
• Englischkenntnisse sind unerlässlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein wesentlicher Vorteil von What We Offer

Vidéo Youtube Avec nos clients, nous combinons les mondes réel et numérique Avec la technologie, les logiciels et les services pour les bâtiments intelligents, nous transformons le quotidien pour tout le monde. En combinant les mondes réel et numérique, nous donnons à nos clients les moyens d'atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et de créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale pour leur peuple. Il ne s'agit pas seulement d'améliorer les bâtiments – il s'agit de créer des environnements efficaces, sûrs, adaptables et durables, qui améliorent la façon dont le monde vit et fonctionne. La transformation numérique des bâtiments est un secteur dynamique et en évolution rapide, qui a besoin de plus que d'une grande technologie. Nous savons qu'une entreprise ne prospère que si ses gens prospèrent, donc chez Siemens nous mettons nos gens en premier. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un collègue motivé comme Technical Trainer Fire Safety Systems pour notre unité d'affaires mondiale des bâtiments. Dans ce rôle, vous êtes responsable de la conception, de la prestation et de l'amélioration continue de programmes de formation technique de haute qualité liés aux systèmes de détection et de sécurité d'incendie Siemens. Vous traduisez des sujets techniques, réglementaires et systémiques complexes en expériences d'apprentissage claires, pratiques et stimulantes pour les employés, les clients et les partenaires internes. Vous combinez une expertise technique approfondie avec de solides compétences didactiques et vous collaborez étroitement avec les intervenants interfonctionnels pour s'assurer que le contenu de formation est aligné sur les développements de produits, les exigences réglementaires et les besoins des clients. Notre voyage partagé pourrait vous emmener n'importe où... où aimeriez-vous aller ? Localisation : cette position sera basée à Zug/Suisse. Prérequis est votre admissibilité légale à travailler en Suisse. Vos nouvelles responsabilités
• Élaboration de programmes de formation : Concevoir, élaborer et maintenir des concepts et des programmes de formation technique complets pour les systèmes et les solutions de sécurité-incendie, traduire des règlements et des architectures complexes en contenus pratiques axés sur l'apprenant pour divers groupes cibles (ingénieurs techniques, techniciens techniques, gestionnaires de projets, soutien technique et utilisateurs finaux)
• Prestation et facilitation de la formation: Planifier, organiser et mener des formations techniques en matière de sécurité incendie sous divers formats (salle de classe, virtuel, hybride), en facilitant à la fois des séances théoriques et des exercices pratiques et à base de systèmes pour tous les niveaux de compétence
• Création et gestion de contenu d'apprentissage : Élaborer, mettre à jour et gérer des outils d'apprentissage de haute qualité, notamment de la documentation, des présentations, des manuels, des exercices et du contenu numérique (p. ex., apprentissage en ligne, vidéos), assurer l'alignement avec les règlements actuels et les versions de produits
• Collaboration et alignement des intervenants : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes (gestion des produits, R-D, soutien technique) pour aligner le contenu de formation sur les mises à jour des produits, les changements réglementaires et les exigences des clients
• Assurance de la qualité et apprentissage continu : recueillir les commentaires des participants pour améliorer continuellement la qualité de la formation, appuyer activement le transfert des connaissances et favoriser une culture de l'apprentissage continu au sein de l'organisation
• Projets spéciaux et mentorat : soutenir ou diriger des programmes de certification/approbation, contribuer à des initiatives de formation à l'échelle mondiale ou régionale, former des experts en matière d'encadrement et des formateurs subalternes Vos compétences et votre expérience
• Diplôme technique en génie électrique, sécurité incendie, technologies du bâtiment ou domaine connexe
• Expérience éprouvée des systèmes de détection d'incendie ou de sécurité, associée à une bonne compréhension des règlements, des normes et des architectures des systèmes pertinents (la certification est un plus)
• Expérience démontrée de la formation technique, du transfert des connaissances ou d'un rôle comparable, y compris idéalement la connaissance des formats d'apprentissage numériques et des outils d'apprentissage en ligne
• Excellente capacité de présentation, de facilitation et de communication, avec la capacité de traduire des sujets techniques complexes en contenus clairs, pratiques et stimulants pour divers publics
• Style de travail structuré, auto-organisé et orienté vers la qualité, confortable avec différents formats d'apprentissage (salle de classe, virtuel, hybride)
• Un esprit de collaboration et de solides compétences en gestion des parties prenantes, idéalement acquises au sein d'une organisation internationale ou matricielle
• La maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle; la maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage important Ce que nous offrons
• Un rôle stimulant et efficace à la pointe de la technologie de la sécurité incendie
• Niveau élevé de responsabilité et d'autonomie dans la formation technique
• Collaboration étroite avec des experts de l'ingénierie, du développement de produits et des équipes de projet
• Possibilités de stimuler les concepts de formation à l ' échelle mondiale et de favoriser l ' amélioration continue
• Soutien dédié à votre perfectionnement professionnel et à votre apprentissage continu
• Pour plus d'informations sur les avantages sociaux des employés, voir ici Ce que c'est de travailler pour nous Nous mettons l'accent sur la promotion d'une culture du travail inclusive et flexible qui encourage chacun à être lui-même authentique. L'égalité des chances et la diversité sont importantes pour nous et contribuent à une culture enrichissante. Nous acceptons activement le travail mobile pour fournir à chaque collègue plus d'autonomie et la chance de parvenir à un bon équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle. descriptionByLocale.en:
We link the real and digital worlds in collaboration with our customers. Siemens is a technological leader who employs approximately 6,000 people. Building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry: our innovative solutions span many fields and shape the world of tomorrow. As a service security project manager at the SES, you have the opportunity to be your own and enjoy great freedom in the planning of customer interventions. Would you also like to contribute to the next innovations and improve the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then this post is for you! Apply today as Security Project Manager at SES (f/h/d) 80-100% and start as soon as possible – your team is looking forward to welcoming you! Your new tasks
• Managing and coordinating security and connectivity systems projects in Western Switzerland
• Monitor updates, upgrades and licence renewals under contracts
• Planning human, software and material resources for projects
• Ensure coordination between clients, technical teams and internal partners
• Supervising the connectivity of electronic security systems (video surveillance, access control)
• Deploy and maintain digital solutions and new technologies such as Building X, Security Manager
• Be the main point of contact for key customers and ensure a close relationship
• Ensuring timeliness, budgets and quality standards
• Participate in digitization and process optimization initiatives
• Train end-users and ensure effective technical support Your talents and experience
• Technical or engineering degree in electricity, automation, computer or equivalent (HES / ES)
• Minimum 3 years experience in technical project management, ideally in the fields of security, automation or connected systems
• Good knowledge of corporate computer networks such as Domain, Windows server, Active directory, SQL etc.
• Experience with Building X solutions is an asset
• Good mastery of standard IT tools
• Proactive, communicative and customer-oriented personality with a strong team spirit
• Ability to work independently and take initiatives
• Excellent communication skills in French and good knowledge in English
• Ideally located in the canton of Vaud or the Lausanne region Your advantages
• Your own electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Self-employment and flexibility, and freedom to plan your interventions
• Many opportunities for development and further training
• Paid continuing training
• Find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment Siemens Switzerland's culture is much more than just a work environment: it is at the heart of our daily collaboration and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a forward-looking working environment, with a focus on innovation, sustainable development and personal development. We distinguish ourselves by our individual responsibility, equality of opportunity and diversity, which allow each employee to invest in a genuine way. We implement flexible work models and mobile work to enable our staff to find a balance between work and privacy. Find more information and discover with our culture quiz if you are suitable for Siemens! " Siemens stands for quality, innovation and sustainability! I fully identify with these values. » (Process Manager) News and Stories Discover for yourself how technological innovations can already transform our lives. If you want to know more about projects that can be implemented using Siemens technology, here you will find some current examples . Frequently asked questions and your interlocutor Here you will find a summary of frequently asked questions and the possibility to contact us directly. I'm looking forward to your application! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Your journey to Siemens - How we hire Information on the placement of staff: Siemens Switzerland does not accept applications from the placement of staff. Thank you for your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We connect real and digital worlds in collaboration with our customers. Your role: At the heart of innovation in building automation for HVAC installations, you accompany our MCR integrators clients at each stage of their projects: understanding the need, technical advice, choice of solutions, encryption and follow-up until completion. Your mission: Make a difference, propose the right solutions, create a lasting trust relationship, and make a concrete contribution to tomorrow's home — more connected, more sustainable, smarter. Would you like to contribute to the next innovations and improve the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then this job is for you! Apply today as Commercial Engineer – Building Automation & MCR 80-100% (e/h/d) and start from 01.08.2026 – your team are looking forward to welcoming! Your new tasks
• Technical reference & ambassador of our solutions: support MCR clients and partners in the integration of our solutions, both in new and in renovation.
• Sharing innovation and making technology simple: valuing our technologies, disseminating innovations and transforming complex projects into clear and accessible solutions.
• Preferred interlocutor for electrical customers: understand the needs, advise and propose tailored solutions.
• Pilot commercial activity: present, build and follow commercial offers and tenders with rigour and commitment.
• Develop sustainable relationships: ensure regular visits, maintain the network, and ensure a rigorous CRM update.
• Making each project a success: working closely with internal and external teams to turn ideas into concrete results and satisfaction for our partners. Your talents and experience
• Technical building training CVC: Diploma ET or SWC in CVC/CRM.
• Experience confirmed: several years in CVC and or RCM technologies, ideally on new construction and/or renovation projects.
• Relationship strength: excellent communication skills, listening skills, strong customer orientation.
• Negotiation & business spirit: ability to convince, build win-win solutions and develop lasting relationships.
• Tools: good mastery of standard tools (e.g. Office 365, SAP, Salesforce) and ABT-site, ACS790 or similar tools.
• Languages: excellent knowledge of French; German and/or English are real assets. Your Benefits
• Public transport subscription at reduced prices
• Many opportunities for development and further training
• Access to employee share plans

Wir verbinden reale und digitale Welten in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden. Ihre Rolle: Im Mittelpunkt der Innovation in der Gebäudeautomation für HVAC-Installationen begleiten Sie unsere Kunden von MCR-Integratoren in jeder Phase ihrer Projekte: Verständnis des Bedarfs, technische Beratung, Auswahl der Lösungen, Verschlüsselung und Nachverfolgung bis zur Fertigstellung. Ihre Mission: Machen Sie einen Unterschied, schlagen Sie die richtigen Lösungen vor, schaffen Sie eine dauerhafte Vertrauensbeziehung und leisten Sie einen konkreten Beitrag zum Zuhause von morgen - vernetzter, nachhaltiger, intelligenter. Möchten Sie zu den nächsten Innovationen beitragen und das Leben von Millionen Menschen in der Schweiz verbessern? Dann ist dieser Job für Sie! Bewerben Sie sich noch heute als Commercial Engineer – Building Automation & MCR 80-100% (e/h/d) und starten Sie ab dem 01.08.2026 – Ihr Team freut sich auf Begrüßung! Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Technische Referenz & Botschafter unserer Lösungen: Unterstützung von MCR Kunden und Partnern bei der Integration unserer Lösungen, sowohl bei Neu- als auch bei der Renovierung.
• Innovation teilen und Technologie einfach machen: unsere Technologien bewerten, Innovationen verbreiten und komplexe Projekte in klare und zugängliche Lösungen verwandeln.
• Bevorzugter Gesprächspartner für elektrische Kunden: die Bedürfnisse verstehen, beraten und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen vorschlagen.
• Kommerzielle Pilottätigkeit: Präsentieren, Bauen und Befolgen von kommerziellen Angeboten und Ausschreibungen mit Strenge und Engagement.
• Entwickeln Sie nachhaltige Beziehungen: Sorgen Sie für regelmäßige Besuche, pflegen Sie das Netzwerk und sorgen Sie für ein strenges CRM-Update.
• Jedes Projekt zum Erfolg führen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Teams, um Ideen in konkrete Ergebnisse und Zufriedenheit für unsere Partner umzusetzen. Ihre Talente und Erfahrungen
• Technische Gebäudeausbildung CVC: Diplom ET oder SWC in CVC / CRM.
• Erfahrung bestätigt: mehrere Jahre in CVC- und/oder RCM-Technologien, idealerweise bei Neubau- und/oder Renovierungsprojekten.
• Beziehungsstärke: hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Hörfähigkeiten, starke Kundenorientierung.
• Verhandlungs- und Geschäftsgeist: Fähigkeit zu überzeugen, Win-Win-Lösungen aufzubauen und dauerhafte Beziehungen aufzubauen.
• Tools: gute Beherrschung von Standard-Tools (z. B. Office 365, SAP, Salesforce) und ABT-Site, ACS790 oder ähnliche Tools.
• Sprachen: ausgezeichnete Französischkenntnisse; Deutsch und/oder Englisch sind echte Vermögenswerte. Ihre Vorteile
• Abonnement für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zu ermäßigten Preisen
• Viele Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung und Weiterbildung
• Zugang zu Mitarbeiteraktienplänen
• Alle Vorteile finden Sie hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur – Ihre neue Arbeitswelt Die Kultur von Siemens Schweiz ist viel mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld: Sie steht im Mittelpunkt unserer täglichen Zusammenarbeit und ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsweisendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Fokus auf Innovation, nachhaltige Entwicklung und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir zeichnen uns durch unsere individuelle Verantwortung, Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt aus, die es jedem Mitarbeiter ermöglichen, wirklich zu investieren. descriptionByLocale.en:
We connect real and digital worlds in collaboration with our customers. Siemens is a technological leader who employs approximately 6,000 people. Building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry: our innovative solutions span many fields and shape the world of tomorrow. The energy market needs partners capable of offering reliable solutions through comprehensive services and innovative ideas. We are professionals in this field. Energy production, transmission and distribution, as well as management systems, automation and control-command are the pillars of our business line. Protection systems for high and medium voltage installations ensure our energy supply. Would you also like to contribute to the next innovations and improve the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then this post is for you! Apply today as a Medium Voltage Project Leader (f/h/d) and start from 01.11.2026 – your team is looking forward to welcoming you! Your new tasks
• Active support for the sale of medium voltage installations (definition of concepts, project studies, preparation and submission of tenders, price indications).
• Project management with responsibility for monitoring costs, timelines and quality. These activities require - depending on the projects - to ensure on-site coordination of assembly and commissioning, as well as to organize the delivery of the installation to the customer.
• On-site customer assistance and training on products and facilities in the field of medium voltage.
• Responsibility for receptions of our installations and systems in the various Siemens plants.
• Participation in customer events and trade shows.
• Maintain contact with internal and external services, including customers, electricity distribution companies, engineering offices, our production plants, our parent company and our research offices. Your talents and experience
• Electrician/Electrician or equivalent level electrotechnical training
• Mastery of standard IT tools like MS Office
• Experience in electricity (at least three years) is desirable
• Knowledge of distribution networks and project management, an asset
• Client-oriented, stress-resistant, committed and autonomous. In addition you are structured, communicative and proactive
• As a French mother tongue, you have more good knowledge of the German second language (oral and written). English is an additional asset. Your Benefits
• 2 to 3 days/week of mobile work by default
• Public transport subscription at reduced prices and free parking
• Many opportunities for development and further training
• Access to employee share plans
• Find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment Siemens Switzerland's culture is much more than just a work environment: it is at the heart of our daily collaboration and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a forward-looking working environment, with a focus on innovation, sustainable development and personal development. We distinguish ourselves by our individual responsibility, equality of opportunity and diversity, which allow each employee to invest in a genuine way. We implement flexible work models and mobile work to enable our staff to find a balance between work and privacy. Find more information and discover with our culture quiz if you are suitable for Siemens!
