jobs.description:
We transform buildings With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing and dynamic sector — and it needs more than great technology. It needs great people. About the Role The Planner Office is one of Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings’ strategic growth initiatives, designed to strengthen engagement with planners, consultants, designers and other specification influencers worldwide and increase Siemens’ influence in the early project phase. As part of the Global Planner Office Team, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Product Management and regional organizations. Together, we develop new initiatives and identify opportunities to strengthen Siemens’ collaboration with planners, consultants, designers and other specification influencers around the world. Our shared journey could take you anywhere – where would you like to go? Your Mission Help shape and scale Siemens’ global Planner Office ecosystem by driving collaboration across regions and strengthening our engagement with planners, consultants, designers and other specification influencers worldwide. Your new responsibilities: Drive Planner Office Growth
• Support the rollout and continuous development of Planner Offices across our global organization
• Help local teams increase their maturity and maximize business impact Shape the Future of Planner Engagement
• Contribute to new concepts and engagement approaches for planners and consultants
• Identify opportunities to strengthen Siemens' early-phase influence and consultant engagement
• Collaborate across HQ functions, regional organizations and the global Planner Office network Your skills and experience:
• 5+ years of experience in the Smart Buildings industry , ideally gained within a planning office, consulting company, engineering firm, design office or customer-facing Siemens role. First-hand experience working with planners, consultants or designers is highly valued
• A broad understanding of Smart Building technologies , solutions, specification processes and consultant needs
• A natural relationship builder with the ability to establish trust and collaborate effectively across functions, countries and cultures
• A proactive team player who enjoys taking ownership, driving initiatives forward and turning ideas into action
• Experienced in navigating complex matrix organizations , influencing stakeholders and achieving results without direct authority
• An excellent communicator , capable of translating complex topics into clear and compelling messages for different audiences
• A curious and entrepreneurial mindset , energized by shaping new concepts, challenging the status quo and creating impact
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
• Familiarity with sales processes, CRM tools and business workflows
• Fluent in English ; additional languages (e.g. German) are considered a plus
• Travel activity ca. 30%
• Start upon agreement What's In It for You
• Be part of a global growth initiative with exciting development opportunities within the Planner & Consultant ecosystem , helping shape the future of planner engagement at Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings
• Work in an international environment , collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across regions and functions
• Benefit from Siemens’ flexible hybrid working model , supporting both collaboration and work-life balance Location : this role can be based in Zug/Switzerland or Frankfurt am Main/Germany. Please note that qualified candidates need to be legally eligible for work authorization in the respective location. Relocation is not required. Requisiti - 5+ anni di esperienza nel settore Smart Buildings, idealmente acquisita all'interno di un ufficio di progettazione, società di consulenza, società di ingegneria, ufficio di progettazione o di fronte al cliente Siemens ruolo.

Un'esperienza diretta nel lavoro con pianificatori, consulenti o designer è molto apprezzata - Un'ampia comprensione delle tecnologie, delle soluzioni, dei processi di specificazione e delle esigenze di consulenza Smart Building - Un costruttore di relazioni naturali con la capacità di stabilire fiducia e collaborare efficacemente tra funzioni, paesi e culture - Un team player proattivo che gode di avere la proprietà, portare avanti iniziative e trasformare le idee in azione - Esperto nella navigazione di organizzazioni a matrice complesse, influenzando gli stakeholder e ottenendo risultati senza autorità diretta - Un eccellente

comunicativo, capace di tradurre argomenti complessi in messaggi chiari e avvincenti per diversi pubblico - Una mentalità curiosa e imprenditoriale, stimolata dalla formazione di nuovi concetti, sfidando lo status quo e creando impatto - Laurea in Business, Ingegneria o un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza professionale - Fa 19000ty con processi di vendita, strumenti CRM e flussi di lavoro aziendali - Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive (es.

Tedesco) sono considerati un plus - Attività di viaggio ca. 30%

Cosa offriamo - Partecipa a un'iniziativa di crescita globale con emozionanti opportunità di sviluppo all'interno dell'ecosistema Planner & Consultant, contribuendo a plasmare il futuro dell'impegno dei pianificatori presso Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings - Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale, collaborare con colleghi e stakeholder in varie regioni e funzioni - Approfittate di Siemens. modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile, supportando sia la collaborazione che l'equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e vita lavorativa

Contatto - Località: questo ruolo può essere basato a Zug/Svizzera o Francoforte sul Meno/Germania. La ricollocazione non è necessaria. - Si prega di consultare le domande frequenti e le informazioni di contatto per maggiori dettagli.

Im Rahmen des Global Planner Office Teams arbeiten Sie eng mit Kollegen aus Marketing, Vertrieb, Produktmanagement und regionalen Organisationen zusammen.

Gemeinsam entwickeln wir neue Initiativen und identifizieren Möglichkeiten, Siemens, die Zusammenarbeit mit Planern, Beratern, Designern und anderen Spezifikationsinfluencern weltweit zu stärken.

Ihre Mission Gestalten und skalieren Sie Siemens, das Ökosystem des globalen Planner Office, indem Sie die Zusammenarbeit über Regionen hinweg vorantreiben und unser Engagement mit Planern, Beratern, Designern und anderen Spezifikationsinfluencern weltweit stärken.

Verantwortung - Drive Planner Office Wachstum - Unterstützung des Rollouts und der kontinuierlichen Entwicklung von Planner Offices in unserer globalen Organisation - Unterstützung lokaler Teams bei der Steigerung ihrer Reife und der Maximierung der Geschäftswirkung - Gestalten Sie die Zukunft des Planners - Beitrag zu neuen Konzepten und Engagements für Planer und Berater - Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, Siemenss Einfluss in der Frühphase und Berater-Engagement zu stärken - Zusammenarbeit über HQ-Funktionen, regionale Organisationen und das globale Planner Office Netzwerk

Voraussetzungen - 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Smart Buildings Industrie, ideal in einem Planungsbüro, Beratungsunternehmen, Ingenieurbüro, Designbüro oder Kunden-begeisterten Siemens Rolle gewonnen.

Kommunikator, in der Lage, komplexe Themen in klare und überzeugende Botschaften für verschiedene Zielgruppen übersetzen - Eine neugierige und unternehmerische Denkweise, durch die Gestaltung neuer Konzepte, Herausforderungen des Status Quo und die Schaffung von Auswirkungen - Bachelor, Abschluss in Business, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich, oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung - Vertrautheit mit Verkaufsprozessen, CRM-Tools und Business-Workflows - Fluent in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen (z.B..

Deutsch) als Plus - Reiseaktivität ca. 30%

Description Nous transformons les bâtiments Avec la technologie, les logiciels et les services pour les bâtiments intelligents, nous transformons le quotidien pour tous. En combinant les mondes réel et numérique, nous autonomisons nos clients à atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, à réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et à créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale.

À propos du rôle Le bureau de planification est l'un des bâtiments d'infrastructure intelligente Siemens, des initiatives de croissance stratégique, conçu pour renforcer l'engagement avec les planificateurs, consultants, concepteurs et autres intrusion de spécifications dans le monde entier et augmenter Siemens, l'influence dans la phase de projet précoce.

Ensemble, nous développons de nouvelles initiatives et identifions des opportunités pour renforcer Siemens, la collaboration avec les planificateurs, les consultants, les concepteurs et d'autres intrusion de spécifications dans le monde.

Votre mission Aidez à façonner et à échafauder Siemens, l'écosystème mondial de Planner Office en favorisant la collaboration entre les régions et en renforçant notre engagement avec les planificateurs, les consultants, les concepteurs et d'autres intrusion de spécifications dans le monde entier.

Responsabilités - Favoriser la croissance des bureaux des planificateurs - Appuyer le déploiement et le développement continu des bureaux des planificateurs dans notre organisation mondiale - Aider les équipes locales à accroître leur maturité et à maximiser l'impact commercial - Façonner l'avenir de l'engagement des planificateurs - Contribuer à de nouveaux concepts et à de nouvelles approches de mobilisation pour les planificateurs et les consultants - Identifier les occasions de renforcer l'influence de Siemens en phase initiale et l'engagement des consultants - Collaborer à l'échelle des fonctions de l'AC, des organisations régionales et du réseau mondial des bureaux des planificateurs

Exigences - 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'industrie des bâtiments intelligents, idéalement gagné dans un bureau de planification, société de conseil, firme d'ingénierie, bureau de conception ou face à la clientèle Siemens.

Une expérience de première main avec les planificateurs, les consultants ou les concepteurs est très appréciée - Une compréhension large des technologies de construction intelligente, des solutions, des processus de spécification et des besoins des consultants - Un bâtisseur de relations naturelles avec la capacité d'établir la confiance et de collaborer efficacement entre les fonctions, les pays et les cultures - Un joueur d'équipe proactif qui aime prendre en main les initiatives, faire avancer les initiatives et transformer les idées en action - Expérience dans la navigation des organisations matricielles complexes, influencer les parties prenantes et obtenir des résultats sans autorité directe - Un excellent

, capable de traduire des sujets complexes en messages clairs et convaincants pour différents publics - Un état d'esprit curieux et entrepreneurial, stimulé par la formation de nouveaux concepts, la remise en question du statu quo et la création d'impact - Baccalauréat, diplôme en affaires, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou une expérience professionnelle équivalente - Familiarité avec les processus de vente, les outils CRM et les workflows d'affaires - Fluent en anglais ; langues supplémentaires (par exemple :

Les chiffres sont considérés comme un plus - Activité de voyage environ 30%

Ce que nous offrons - Faites partie d'une initiative de croissance mondiale avec des opportunités de développement passionnantes au sein de l'écosystème Planner & Consultant, aidant à façonner l'avenir de l'engagement des planificateurs chez Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings - Travailler dans un environnement international, en collaborant avec des collègues et des parties prenantes dans les régions et les fonctions - Bénéficiez de Siemens, modèle de travail hybride flexible, en soutenant la collaboration et l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée

Contact - Emplacement : ce rôle peut être basé à Zug/Suisse ou Francfort-sur-le-Main/Allemagne. Veuillez noter que les candidats qualifiés doivent être légalement éligibles à l'autorisation de travail dans leur lieu de résidence respectif.

jobs.description:
Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen verbinden wir die reale und die digitale Welt. Als eines der führenden Technologieunternehmen beschäftigt Siemens in der Schweiz rund 6000 Mitarbeitende. Mit unseren wegweisenden Lösungen in den Bereichen Gebäudetechnik, Energie, Mobilität, Gesundheit und Industrie gestalten wir die Zukunft.  #TomorrowWithUs Du möchtest ein Team von Fachexpert:innen führen, technisches Know-how bündeln und Kund:innen mit erstklassigen und zugeschnittenen Automatisierungslösungen begeistern? Als agile Führungskraft lebst du den Kulturwandel hinsichtlich Digitalisierung und KI vor und förderst ihn aktiv, wobei du deine ständige Bereitschaft zur Weiterentwicklung auf dein Team überträgst. Zudem bist du Teil des erweiterten Führungskreises der Schweizer DI Sales Organisation und übernimmst gemeinsam mit deinem Team die Verantwortung für die Geschäftsentwicklung eines definierten Teils des DI Gesamtportfolios. Durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit den DI Sales-Kanälen und gezielte und abgestimmte Massnahmen tragt ihr massgeblich zur Steigerung des Verkaufsvolumens und zur zukunftsorientierten Weiterentwicklung des Portfolios bei. Willst auch du aktiv die Zukunft mitgestalten und Millionen von Menschen in der Schweiz beeinflussen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bewirb dich noch heute als  Teamleiter Technical & Specialist Support - Automation . Dein neuen Aufgaben
• Du und dein Team seid ein integraler Bestandteil der DI Sales Acceleration Organisation und du übernimmst die volle Geschäftsverantwortung für die Technologie-Portfoliogruppe Automation.
• In dieser Funktion verantwortest du alle Vertriebs-, Promotions- und Fachberatungsaktivitäten innerhalb der Portfoliogruppe in der Schweiz und führst ein Team mit 8 Mitarbeitenden.
• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Teammitgliedern stellst du sicher, dass der Geschäftsbetrieb reibungslos und ordnungsgemäss abläuft.
• Proaktiv treibst du die Ausarbeitung von Strategien zur Kundenentwicklung und zur Steigerung der Marktausschöpfung – stets in enger Abstimmung mit den Vertriebsteams.
• Als Partner:in berätst du Kund:innen hinsichtlich ihrer digitalen Transformation und ihrer internationalen Geschäftsentwicklungen.
• Die strategische Kapazitäts- und Kompetenzplanung liegt ebenfalls in deiner Verantwortung.
• Auf Basis unserer Eigentümerkultur und eines ausgeprägten Growth Mindset motivierst du dein Team und die gesamte Organisation, kontinuierlich besser zu werden. Deine Talente und Erfahrungen
• Die Basis deines Erfolgs bildet ein abgeschlossenes technisches oder betriebswirtschaftliches Studium.
• Darauf aufbauend überzeugst du mit Vertriebs- und Promotionserfahrung im Produkt- und Systemgeschäft innerhalb der Automatisiserungstechnik.
• Zusätzlich verfügst du über Kenntnisse der branchenspezifischen Automatisierungslösungen, der Digitalisierungs- und Antriebstechnologien sowie der zugehörigen Portfolioelemente der Digital Industries.
• Ausserdem bringst du bereits disziplinarische und fachliche Führungserfahrung in multikulturellen Teams mit und hast auch Erfahrung in der Geschäftsverantwortung.
• Branchen- und Geschäftsausweitung, Kundenorientierung und Vertrieb sind deine Passion.
• Du bist eine Persönlichkeit, die ihre Organisation befähigt und motiviert, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten, um gemeinsam ambitionierte Ziele zu erreichen.
• Du hast Erfahrung in der internationalen Zusammenarbeit und bewegst dich sicher in der Management-Kommunikation mit grossen Kund:innen.
• Dein Veränderungswille, dein Durchsetzungsvermögen und deine interkulturelle Kompetenz befähigen dich zur Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe über Geschäftsbereiche, Vertriebskanäle und Regionen hinweg.
• Dein Profil ist durch verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse abgerundet, Kenntnisse in Französisch wären ein Pluspunkt. Deine Vorteile
• 2 bis 3 Tage pro Woche mobiles Arbeiten als globaler Standard
• Vergünstigtes ÖV-Abo und Gratisparkplätze
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowohl für deine berufliche als auch persönliche Entwicklung
• Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
• Alle Vorteile findest du hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur – dein neues Arbeitsumfeld Die Kultur bei Siemens Schweiz ist mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld – sie ist das Herzstück unseres täglichen Miteinanders und der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, das von Innovation, Nachhaltigkeit und persönlicher Entfaltung geprägt ist. Wir zeichnen uns durch Eigenverantwortung, Chancengerechtigkeit und Vielfalt aus, in der sich jede:r Mitarbeitende authentisch einbringen kann. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobiles Arbeiten sind bei uns gelebte Realität und ermöglichen unseren Mitarbeitenden eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Erfahre mehr und entdecke mit unserem Kulturquiz , ob du zu Siemens passt! Häufig gestellte Fragen und deine Ansprechperson Hier findest du eine Sammlung häufig gestellter Fragen sowie die Möglichkeit, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Ich freue mich auf deine Bewerbung. Alina Talent Acquisition Partner Dein Weg zu Siemens – How we hire Information für Personalvermittlungen: Siemens Schweiz nimmt für diese Position keine Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlungen entgegen. Vielen Dank für das Verständnis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, connettiamo il mondo reale e digitale. Come una delle principali aziende tecnologiche, Siemens impiega circa 6.000 persone in Svizzera. Con le nostre soluzioni innovative nei settori della tecnologia dell'edilizia, dell'energia, della mobilità, della salute e dell'industria, stiamo plasmando il futuro. Vuoi guidare un team di esperti, fare un bundle di know-how tecnico e ispirare i clienti con soluzioni di automazione di prima classe e su misura? Come leader agile, esemplificare e promuovere attivamente il cambiamento culturale per quanto riguarda la digitalizzazione e l'IA, trasferendo la vostra costante volontà di sviluppare al vostro team. Inoltre, fai parte del gruppo di gestione esteso dell'Organizzazione svizzera delle vendite DI e, insieme al tuo team, ti assumerai la responsabilità dello sviluppo aziendale di una parte definita del portafoglio generale DI. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione con i canali di vendita DI e misure mirate e coordinate, contribuisce in modo significativo all'aumento del volume delle vendite e all'ulteriore sviluppo orientato al futuro del portafoglio. Vuoi anche plasmare attivamente il futuro e influenzare milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora hai proprio ragione con noi! Applicare oggi come Team Leader: nelle vendite tecniche (Portfolio Group Automation) e iniziare immediatamente o con un accordo – il vostro team vi aspetta! Le nuove attività
• Voi e il vostro team siete parte integrante dell'organizzazione DI Sales Acceleration e assumete la piena responsabilità aziendale per il gruppo di portafoglio tecnologia Automation.
• In questo ruolo, sarai responsabile di tutte le attivitÃ di vendita, promozione e consulenza all'interno del gruppo portafoglio in Svizzera e guiderai un team di 8 dipendenti.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i membri del vostro team, assicurarsi che le operazioni aziendali funzionino senza problemi e correttamente.
• Proattivamente sviluppare strategie per lo sviluppo del cliente e l'assorbimento del mercato – sempre in stretto coordinamento con i team di vendita.
• Come partner, consiglia ai clienti la loro trasformazione digitale e gli sviluppi aziendali internazionali.
• La pianificazione strategica delle capacità e delle competenze è anche vostra responsabilità.
• Sulla base della nostra cultura di proprietà e di una forte mentalità di crescita, motivate il vostro team e l'intera organizzazione a migliorare continuamente. I tuoi talenti ed esperienze
• La base del vostro successo è uno studio tecnico o aziendale completato.
• In base a questo, convincerai con esperienza di vendita e promozione nel settore dei prodotti e sistemi all'interno della tecnologia di automazione.
• Inoltre, hai la conoscenza di soluzioni di automazione specifiche del settore, tecnologie di digitalizzazione e di azionamento e gli elementi di portafoglio associati di Digital Industries.
• Inoltre, hai già esperienza di leadership disciplinare e professionale in team multiculturali e esperienza nella responsabilità aziendale.
• L'espansione industriale e commerciale, l'orientamento del cliente e le vendite sono la vostra passione.
• Sei una persona che abilita e motiva la tua organizzazione a raggiungere il suo potenziale insieme per raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi.
• Hai esperienza nella cooperazione internazionale e ti muovi con fiducia nella comunicazione di gestione con grandi clienti.
• La vostra disponibilità a cambiare, la vostra assertività e la vostra competenza interculturale vi permettono di lavorare insieme su un piano di parità tra aree di business, canali di distribuzione e regioni.
• Il tuo profilo è arrotondato da una conoscenza affidabile di tedesco e inglese, la conoscenza del francese sarebbe un plus. I vantaggi
• 2–3 giorni / settimana lavoro mobile è standard
• Abbonamento ÖV e parcheggio gratuito
• Ulteriori opportunità di istruzione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale
• Accesso ai piani azionari dei dipendenti
• La nostra cultura aziendale - il tuo nuovo ambiente di lavoro La cultura della Siemens Svizzera è più che un semplice ambiente di lavoro: è al centro della nostra collaborazione quotidiana e della chiave del nostro successo. Siemens Svizzera offre un ambiente di lavoro orientato al futuro caratterizzato da innovazione, sostenibilità e sviluppo personale. Siamo caratterizzati da responsabilità personale, pari opportunità e diversità, in cui ogni dipendente può contribuire in modo autentico. I modelli di lavoro flessibili e il lavoro mobile sono una realtà per noi e permettono ai nostri dipendenti di raggiungere un equilibrio equilibrato della vita lavorativa. Scopri di più e scopri con il nostro quiz culturale se sei adatto per Siemens! Siemens è uno dei pionieri della tecnologia, e fare parte di esso mi rende orgoglioso. » (Team Leader) Notizie e Storie Ottieni un senso di come la tecnologia innovativa può cambiare il nostro presente. Se volete saperne di più su quali progetti possono essere implementati utilizzando la tecnologia Siemens, ecco alcuni esempi attuali. Domande frequenti e la persona di contatto Qui troverete una raccolta di domande frequenti e la possibilità di contattarci direttamente. Diana Talent Acquisition Partner La tua strada per Siemens – Come assumere informazioni per agenzie di reclutamento: Siemens Svizzera non accetta richieste di reclutamento per questa posizione. Grazie per la vostra comprensione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. You want to lead a team of experts, bundle technical know-how and inspire customers with first-class and tailor-made automation solutions? As an agile leader, you exemplify and actively promote cultural change with regard to digitalization and AI, transferring your constant willingness to develop to your team. In addition, you are part of the extended management group of the Swiss DI Sales Organization and, together with your team, assume responsibility for the business development of a defined part of the DI overall portfolio. Through close cooperation with the DI sales channels and targeted and coordinated measures, you contribute significantly to the increase in sales volume and the future-oriented further development of the portfolio. Do you also want to actively shape the future and influence millions of people in Switzerland? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as Team Leader: in Technical Sales (Portfolio Group Automation) and start immediately or by agreement – your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• You and your team are an integral part of the DI Sales Acceleration organization and you assume full business responsibility for the Automation technology portfolio group.
• In this role, you will be responsible for all sales, promotion and consulting activities within the portfolio group in Switzerland and lead a team of 8 employees.
• Working closely with your team members, you ensure that business operations run smoothly and properly.
• Proactively develop strategies for customer development and market uptake – always in close coordination with the sales teams.
• As a partner, you advise customers on their digital transformation and international business developments.
• Strategic capacity and competence planning is also your responsibility.
• Based on our ownership culture and a strong growth mindset, you motivate your team and the entire organization to continuously improve. Your talents and experiences
• The basis of your success is a completed technical or business studies.
• Based on this, you will convince with sales and promotion experience in the product and systems business within automation technology.
• In addition, you have knowledge of industry-specific automation solutions, digitalization and drive technologies and the associated portfolio elements of Digital Industries.
• In addition, you already have disciplinary and professional leadership experience in multicultural teams and experience in business responsibility.
• Industry and business expansion, customer orientation and sales are your passion.
• You are a person who empowers and motivates your organization to reach its potential together to achieve ambitious goals.
• You have experience in international cooperation and move confidently in management communication with large customers.
• Your willingness to change, your assertiveness and your intercultural competence enable you to work together on an equal footing across business areas, distribution channels and regions.
• Your profile is rounded off by reliable knowledge of German and English, knowledge of French would be a plus. Your advantages
• 2–3 days/week mobile work is standard
• Discounted ÖV subscription and free parking
• Further education opportunities both for your professional and personal development
• Access to employee stock plans
• Our corporate culture - your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! Siemens is one of the pioneers of technology, and being part of it makes me proud. » (Team Leader) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. Diana Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens – How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Avec nos clients, nous connectons le monde réel et numérique. Comme l'une des principales entreprises technologiques, Siemens emploie environ 6 000 personnes en Suisse. Avec nos solutions révolutionnaires dans les domaines de la technologie du bâtiment, de l'énergie, de la mobilité, de la santé et de l'industrie, nous façonnons l'avenir. Vous voulez diriger une équipe d'experts, regrouper le savoir-faire technique et inspirer les clients avec des solutions d'automatisation de première classe et sur-mesure ? En tant que leader agile, vous incarnez et encouragez activement le changement culturel en matière de numérisation et d'IA, en transférant votre volonté constante de se développer à votre équipe. En outre, vous faites partie du groupe de gestion étendu de la Swiss DI Sales Organization et, avec votre équipe, assumez la responsabilité du développement d'une partie définie du portefeuille global de DI. Grâce à une coopération étroite avec les circuits de vente DI et à des mesures ciblées et coordonnées, vous contribuez de manière significative à l'augmentation du volume des ventes et au développement futur du portefeuille. Voulez-vous également façonner activement l'avenir et influencer des millions de personnes en Suisse ? Alors tu as raison avec nous ! Postulez aujourd'hui en tant que chef d'équipe : en ventes techniques (Portfolio Group Automation) et commencez immédiatement ou d'un commun accord – votre équipe vous attend avec impatience ! Vos nouvelles tâches
• Vous et votre équipe faites partie intégrante de l'organisation DI Sales Acceleration et vous assumez l'entière responsabilité du groupe Automation Technology.
• Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de toutes les activités de vente, de promotion et de conseil au sein du groupe portefeuille en Suisse et dirigerez une équipe de 8 employés.
• En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les membres de votre équipe, vous veillez à ce que les opérations commerciales se déroulent correctement.
• Élaborer des stratégies proactives de développement des clients et d'adoption du marché – toujours en étroite coordination avec les équipes de vente.
• En tant que partenaire, vous conseillez vos clients sur leur transformation numérique et leurs développements commerciaux internationaux.
• La planification stratégique des capacités et des compétences est également votre responsabilité.
• Basé sur notre culture de propriété et une forte croissance d'esprit, vous motivez votre équipe et toute l'organisation à s'améliorer continuellement. Vos talents et expériences
• La base de votre succès est une étude technique ou commerciale achevée.
• Sur cette base, vous convainquez avec l'expérience des ventes et de la promotion dans le secteur des produits et systèmes au sein de la technologie d'automatisation.
• En outre, vous connaissez les solutions d'automatisation spécifiques à l'industrie, les technologies de numérisation et d'entraînement et les éléments de portefeuille associés des Industries numériques.
• De plus, vous avez déjà une expérience en leadership disciplinaire et professionnel dans des équipes multiculturelles et une expérience en responsabilité commerciale.
• L'expansion industrielle et commerciale, l'orientation client et les ventes sont votre passion.
• Vous êtes une personne qui permet et motive votre organisation à atteindre son potentiel ensemble pour atteindre des objectifs ambitieux.
• Vous avez de l'expérience dans la coopération internationale et vous déplacez avec confiance dans la communication de gestion avec de grands clients.
• Votre volonté de changer, votre assurance et votre compétence interculturelle vous permettent de travailler ensemble sur un pied d'égalité entre les secteurs d'activité, les canaux de distribution et les régions.
• Votre profil est complété par une connaissance fiable de l'allemand et de l'anglais, la connaissance du français serait un plus. Vos avantages
• 2–3 jours/semaine de travail mobile est standard
• Abonnement réduit à ÖV et parking gratuit
• Possibilités de formation continue pour votre développement professionnel et personnel
• Accès aux plans d'actions des employés
• Notre culture d'entreprise - votre nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est plus qu'un simple environnement de travail – elle est au cœur de notre coopération quotidienne et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail orienté vers l'avenir caractérisé par l'innovation, la durabilité et le développement personnel. Nous sommes caractérisés par la responsabilité personnelle, l'égalité des chances et la diversité, dans laquelle chaque employé peut contribuer de manière authentique. Des modèles de travail flexibles et mobiles sont une réalité pour nous et permettent à nos employés d'atteindre un équilibre entre le travail et la vie personnelle. descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply as a system technician today: in security technology and access control systems and start immediately or by agreement – your team is looking forward to you! No CV at hand? No problem! If you do not currently have complete application documents, you can alternatively start your application via WhatsApp and contact us directly and easily. Your new tasks
• Commissioning of new access control systems
• Modernisation and extension of existing access control systems
• Remediation and periodic maintenance of existing facilities
• Advising our customers and maintaining the customer relationship
• Instruct smaller groups
• Performing disruptive missions in our Pikett organization
• Area of application Greater Basel or Zurich Your talents and experiences
• Successfully completed basic training in the electrical sector
• Further education in computer science or electrical engineering is advantageous
• Good knowledge of server and network technologies
• Experience in door and safety technology is an advantage
• Sound MS-Office user knowledge
• Engaged and resilient personality
• Excellent knowledge of German
• Preferred place of residence Your advantages
• Your own electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Independent, flexible work and freedom in operational planning
• Many development opportunities
• Paid training
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! “Siemens is one of the pioneers of technology, and being part of it makes me kind of proud.” (Team Leader at Siemens) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. Diana Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens – How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Willst du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Bahnwelt mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Mobility sind der führende Anbieter im Bereich der Mobilität und erweitern ständig unser innovatives Portfolio, das Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierung, Elektrifizierungslösungen, komplette Bahnsysteme und begleitende Dienstleistungen umfasst. Mit rund 800 Fachmitarbeitenden in der Schweiz und 39 600 Mitarbeitenden weltweit gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind unserer Zeit einen Schritt voraus. Du möchtest ein Engineering-Team inspirieren, Verantwortung in anspruchsvollen Bahnprojekten übernehmen und die sichere Mobilität von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Teamleiter:in im Bereich elektronische Stellwerke Simis IS übernimmst du die fachliche und personelle Führung eines engagierten Engineering-Teams. Mit deiner positiven Art schaffst du Orientierung, stärkst den Zusammenhalt und motivierst dein Team, gemeinsam anspruchsvolle Ziele zu erreichen. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein technisches Know-how in spannende Bahnprojekte ein und sorgst mit interdisziplinären Teams für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Stellwerkslösungen. jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Defining the Future of Data Center Infrastructure Data Centers are one of the most dynamic and strategically critical verticals in the global economy. Driven by the explosion of AI workloads, hyperscale expansion, and the emergence of Neo Cloud players, the market represents a transformational growth opportunity for Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings (SI B). We are looking for an exceptional Global Data Center Vertical Lead to define and execute SI B's strategy for this vertical - accelerating market penetration, expanding share of wallet, and positioning Siemens as the partner of choice for next-generation data center assets worldwide. Reporting to the SI B Vertical Lead , you will act as the strategic orchestrator of a global, cross-functional community of Data Center experts - driving alignment, mobilizing expertise, and ensuring cohesive execution across all regions and segments through influence rather than direct authority. Location: this position will be based in Zug/Switzerland, London/UK or Dublin/Ireland. Prerequisite is your legal eligibility to work in the respective country. Your New Responsibilities Strategy & Market Development
• Define and own the SI B Data Center vertical strategy , aligned with global Siemens direction and SI B commercial ambitions
• Develop a comprehensive market segmentation framework across all regions and segments - hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, AI Factory, and Neo Clouds
• Identify white spaces, growth paths, and emerging customer archetypes to continuously evolve SI B's market position
• Translate strategy into clear, actionable execution plans with defined milestones and KPIs Go-To-Market & Business Development
• Define and implement go-to-market strategies for targeted segments and geographies, ensuring broad and effective market coverage
• Build a strategic network of channel partners, system integrators, and ecosystem players to scale reach and execution
• Drive pipeline creation, customer engagement, and investment proposals for new growth opportunities - including Neo Cloud and AI Factory operators Portfolio & Offering Development
• Lead the market introduction of new SI B portfolio offerings , translating customer and market needs into actionable inputs for product and solution development
• Collaborate with Business Units to co-create differentiated value propositions with a strong focus on digitalization, energy efficiency, and operational resilience
• Identify portfolio gaps and ensure SI B's offering remains ahead of market needs Stakeholder Engagement & Community Orchestration
• Animate and coordinate a global community of Data Center functional experts , fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and aligned execution across regions - without direct line management
• Act as the central connector between regional sales teams, business units, marketing, and the SI Global Vertical Lead
• Drive clear priorities, shared frameworks, and strong communication rhythms across the functional community Thought Leadership & External Influence
• Act as the SI B spokesperson for the Data Center vertical - internally and externally
• Build and maintain C-level relationships with key customers, decision-makers, and ecosystem influencers globally
• Drive thought leadership through industry events, integrated marketing campaigns, and corporate initiatives Market Intelligence & Performance
• Gather and analyze market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer intelligence to continuously sharpen strategy in collaboration with Global Data Center team
• Define and track vertical KPIs - coverage, penetration, pipeline, revenue growth, and share of wallet
• Provide regular strategic updates to SI B leadership , translating market signals into business decisions Your Profile Experience
• 15+ years in business development, vertical strategy, or market leadership - within or serving the Data Center industry
• Deep understanding of Data Center market dynamics - hyperscalers, colocations, Neo Clouds, AI Factory operators, regulations, and technology trends
• Strong knowledge of building technologies and digital platforms relevant to data center infrastructure (BMS, EPMS, fire safety, security, digital twins)
• Proven track record of defining and executing strategies with measurable commercial outcomes
• Demonstrated ability to drive results through influence in a global, matrixed environment Key Competencies
• Visionary strategic thinker with operational rigor and a strong growth mindset
• Outstanding ability to influence, engage, and energize cross-functional communities without direct authority
• Natural connector and community builder across diverse, global stakeholder groups
• Excellence in C-level relationship building and stakeholder management
• Strong financial acumen and data-driven decision making
• Excellent communicator and presenter in English; additional European language a plus
• MBA or equivalent preferred
• Willingness to travel globally up to 50% Why This Role?
• Shape the strategic direction of one of SI B's most exciting and fast-growing verticals
• Operate at the intersection of AI, digitalization, and smart infrastructure - where the future is being built today
• Work with a world-class global team backed by Siemens' full portfolio, brand, and resources
• Enjoy the scope, autonomy, and influence to drive real and lasting market impact Employee benefits : local benefits apply Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly. Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo i mondi reali e digitali Con tecnologia, software e servizi per edifici intelligenti, trasformiamo il quotidiano per tutti. Combinando i mondi reali e digitali, possiamo permettere ai nostri clienti di raggiungere i loro obiettivi di decarbonizzazione, abbassare i costi operativi e creare esperienze occupanti di livello mondiale per la loro gente. Non si tratta solo di migliorare gli edifici – si tratta di creare ambienti efficienti, sicuri, adattabili e sostenibili, che migliorano il modo in cui il mondo vive e lavora. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. All'interno del nostro business di edifici, il nostro team globale diversificato vi sosterrà attraverso la vostra carriera e vi sfiderà a crescere in modi nuovi ed eccitanti, come trasformiamo l'infrastruttura del mondo. Il nostro viaggio condiviso potrebbe portarti da qualche parte... dove vorresti andare? Definire il Future of Data Center Infrastructure Data Center è uno dei verticali più dinamici e strategicamente critici nell'economia globale. Spinto dall'esplosione di carichi di lavoro AI, dall'espansione iperscale e dall'emergere di lettori Neo Cloud, il mercato rappresenta un'opportunità di crescita trasformazionale per Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings (SI B). Siamo alla ricerca di un eccezionale Global Data Center Vertical Lead per definire ed eseguire la strategia di SI B per questa verticale - accelerando la penetrazione del mercato, espandendo la quota di portafoglio e posizionando Siemens come partner di scelta per le attività di data center di prossima generazione in tutto il mondo. Segnalando al SI B Vertical Lead, si agirà come orchestratore strategico di una comunità globale e interfunzionale di esperti Data Center - allineamento di guida, mobilizzazione delle competenze, e garantire l'esecuzione coesa in tutte le regioni e segmenti attraverso l'influenza piuttosto che l'autorità diretta. Posizione: questa posizione si svolgerà a Zug/Svizzera, Londra/Regno Unito o Dublino/Irlanda. Prerequisito è l'ammissibilità legale di lavorare nel rispettivo paese. Le nuove responsabilità Strategia & Sviluppo del mercato
• Definire e possedere la strategia verticale SI B Data Center , allineata alla direzione Siemens globale e alle ambizioni commerciali SI B
• Sviluppare un quadro di segmentazione di mercato completo in tutte le regioni e segmenti - iperscale, colocation, enterprise, AI Factory e Neo Clouds
• Identificare spazi bianchi, percorsi di crescita e archetipi dei clienti emergenti per evolvere continuamente la posizione di mercato di SI B
• Tradurre strategia in piani di esecuzione chiari e attuabili con pietre miliari definiti e KPI Go-To-Market & Business Development
• Definire e implementare strategie di go-to-market per segmenti e geografie mirate, garantendo una copertura di mercato ampia ed efficace
• Costruire una rete strategica di partner di canale, integratori di sistema e giocatori di ecosistema per scalare la portata e l'esecuzione

Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Defining the Future of Data Center Infrastructure Data Centers are one of the most dynamic and strategically critical verticals in the global economy. Driven by the explosion of AI workloads, hyperscale expansion, and the emergence of Neo Cloud players, the market represents a transformational growth opportunity for Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings (SI B). We are looking for an exceptional Global Data Center Vertical Lead to define and execute SI B's strategy for this vertical - accelerating market penetration, expanding share of wallet, and positioning Siemens as the partner of choice for next-generation data center assets worldwide. Reporting to the SI B Vertical Lead , you will act as the strategic orchestrator of a global, cross-functional community of Data Center experts - driving alignment, mobilizing expertise, and ensuring cohesive execution across all regions and segments through influence rather than direct authority. Location: this position will be based in Zug/Switzerland, London/UK or Dublin/Ireland. Prerequisite is your legal eligibility to work in the respective country. Your New Responsibilities Strategy & Market Development
• Define and own the SI B Data Center vertical strategy , aligned with global Siemens direction and SI B commercial ambitions

• Define and implement go-to-market strategies for targeted segments and geographies, ensuring broad and effective market coverage
• Build a strategic network of channel partners, system integrators, and ecosystem players to scale reach and execution
• Drive pipeline creation, customer engagement, and investment proposals for new growth opportunities - including Neo Cloud and AI Factory operators Portfolio & Offering Development

• Act as the central connector between regional sales teams, business units, marketing, and the SI Global Vertical Lead
• Drive clear priorities, shared frameworks, and strong communication rhythms across the functional community Thought Leadership & External Influence
• Act as the SI B spokesperson for the Data Center vertical - internally and externally
• Build and maintain C-level relationships with key customers, decision-makers, and ecosystem influencers globally
• Drive thought leadership through industry events, integrated marketing campaigns, and corporate initiatives Market Intelligence & Performance
• Gather and analyze market trends, competitive dynamics, and customer intelligence to continuously sharpen strategy in collaboration with Global Data Center team
• Define and track vertical KPIs - coverage, penetration, pipeline, revenue growth, and share of wallet
• Provide regular strategic updates to SI B leadership , translating market signals into business decisions Your Profile Experience
• 15+ years in business development, vertical strategy, or market leadership - within or serving the Data Center industry

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden verbinden wir die reale und digitale Welt Mit Technologie, Software und Services für intelligente Gebäude verwandeln wir den Alltag für alle. Durch die Kombination der realen und digitalen Welten befähigen wir unsere Kunden, ihre Dekarbonisierungsziele zu erreichen, ihre Betriebskosten zu senken und erstklassige Insassenerlebnisse für ihre Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Es geht nicht nur darum, Gebäude zu verbessern – es geht darum, effiziente, sichere, anpassungsfähige und nachhaltige Umgebungen zu schaffen, die die Art und Weise, wie die Welt lebt und arbeitet, verbessern. Die digitale Transformation von Gebäuden ist ein sich schnell verändernder, dynamischer Sektor, und er braucht mehr als nur großartige Technologie - er braucht auch großartige Menschen. Wir wissen, dass ein Unternehmen nur dann gedeiht, wenn seine Mitarbeiter florieren, also haben wir bei Siemens unsere Mitarbeiter an die erste Stelle gesetzt. Innerhalb unseres Gebäudegeschäfts wird unser vielfältiges globales Team Sie während Ihrer Karriere unterstützen und Sie herausfordern, auf neue und aufregende Weise zu wachsen, während wir die Infrastruktur der Welt verändern. Unsere gemeinsame Reise könnte dich überall hinbringen ... wohin würdest du gerne gehen? descriptionByLocale.fr:
Avec nos clients, nous combinons les mondes réel et numérique Avec la technologie, les logiciels et les services pour les bâtiments intelligents, nous transformons le quotidien pour tout le monde. En combinant les mondes réel et numérique, nous donnons à nos clients les moyens d'atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et de créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale pour leur peuple. Il ne s'agit pas seulement d'améliorer les bâtiments – il s'agit de créer des environnements efficaces, sûrs, adaptables et durables, qui améliorent la façon dont le monde vit et fonctionne. La transformation numérique des bâtiments est un secteur dynamique et en évolution rapide, qui a besoin de plus que d'une grande technologie. Nous savons qu'une entreprise ne prospère que si ses gens prospèrent, donc chez Siemens nous mettons nos gens en premier. Au sein de notre entreprise immobilière, notre équipe mondiale diversifiée vous accompagnera dans votre carrière et vous mettra au défi de croître de nouvelles façons passionnantes, alors que nous transformons l'infrastructure mondiale. Notre voyage partagé pourrait vous emmener n'importe où... où aimeriez-vous aller ? Définir l'avenir des centres de données Les centres de données d'infrastructure sont l'une des verticales les plus dynamiques et les plus stratégiques de l'économie mondiale. Animé par l'explosion des charges de travail de l'IA, l'expansion hyperscale et l'émergence des acteurs Neo Cloud, le marché représente une opportunité de croissance transformationnelle pour Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings (SI B). Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Global Data Center Vertical Lead exceptionnel pour définir et exécuter la stratégie de SI B pour cette verticale - accélérer la pénétration du marché, élargir la part de portefeuille, et positionner Siemens comme le partenaire de choix pour les actifs de centres de données de nouvelle génération dans le monde entier. Relevant du SI B Vertical Lead , vous agirez comme orchestre stratégique d'une communauté globale et interfonctionnelle d'experts du Data Center - conduisant l'alignement, mobilisant l'expertise et assurant une exécution cohérente dans toutes les régions et tous les segments par l'influence plutôt que l'autorité directe. Lieu: cette position sera basée à Zug/Suisse, Londres/Royaume-Uni ou Dublin/Irlande. Préalable est votre admissibilité légale à travailler dans le pays respectif. • Développer un cadre global de segmentation du marché dans toutes les régions et tous les segments - hyperéchelle, colocation, entreprise, usine d'IA et Neo Clouds
• Identifier les espaces blancs, les trajectoires de croissance et les archétypes de clients émergents afin d'évoluer continuellement la position de SI B sur le marché
• Traduire la stratégie en plans d'exécution clairs et réalisables avec des étapes définies et des ICR Go-To-Market & Business Development
• Définir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de mise en marché pour des segments et des géographies ciblés, en assurant une couverture large et efficace du marché
• Construire un réseau stratégique de partenaires de canaux, d'intégrateurs de systèmes et d'acteurs de l'écosystème afin d'élargir la portée et l'exécution
• Conduire la création de pipelines, l'engagement des clients et les propositions d'investissement pour de nouvelles opportunités de croissance - y compris Neo Cloud et les opérateurs AI Factory Portfolio & Offer Development
• Diriger l'introduction sur le marché de nouvelles offres de portefeuille SI B , en traduisant les besoins des clients et du marché en intrants concrets pour le développement de produits et de solutions
• Collaborer avec les Business Units pour co-créer des propositions de valeur différenciée en mettant fortement l'accent sur la numérisation, l'efficacité énergétique et la résilience opérationnelle
• Identifier les lacunes du portefeuille et s'assurer que l'offre de l'ISB demeure en avance sur les besoins du marché.

• Diriger le leadership de la pensée par des événements industriels, des campagnes de marketing intégrées et des initiatives d'entreprise.

• Très bonne connaissance dans le domaine mécanique ainsi que la connaissance électrique, associée à l'inventivité, l'imagination et la créativité
• Bonne connaissance de SAP (Warehouse Management System et Enterprise Resource Planning, usine de matériel, commandes, réservations) ainsi que l'expérience dans le traitement des produits Siemens
• Vous êtes une personnalité indépendante, fiable et résistante avec la plus grande précision et une communication forte
• Négociation-connaissance de l'allemand dans la parole et l'écriture que vous apportez, connaissance de base du français et de l'anglais vous avez l'avantage
• Rôle central dans la fabrication de produits pour SI-CH avec une influence directe sur le développement de produits
• Activité variée entre production, achats et logistique
• Travail indépendant, flexibilité et liberté dans la planification opérationnelle
• Abonnement réduit à ÖV et parking gratuit

jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. We empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. As Executive Assistant , you will support the Head of Building Products and the Head of Finance, Building Products . Building Products is a global unit within Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings focused on developing innovative building technologies, software, and digital solutions that help customers create more sustainable, efficient, and intelligent buildings. In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted partner to both leaders and play an important part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the organization. You will work closely with colleagues and business partners across functions and geographies, helping to coordinate priorities, facilitate communication, and support key business activities in a dynamic international environment. Our team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? Your new responsibilities
• Provide proactive high-level administrative and organizational support to the Head of Building Products and the Head of Finance, Building Products, in a dynamic international environment
• Act as a trusted point of contact and facilitate effective communication and information flow between the Head of Building Products, Head of Finance, Chief of Staff, leadership team, assistant network, and other key stakeholders
• Help protect leadership focus and effectiveness by proactively anticipating calendar conflicts, highlighting priority clashes, and ensuring adequate preparation time for critical discussions and decision-making forums
• Handle confidential correspondence and communications in English and German with the highest level of professionalism and discretion
• Manage complex agendas, leadership meetings, and priorities across multiple time zones. Ensure agendas, pre-reads, materials, and participant lists are collected, coordinated, and distributed on time, in close collaboration with the Chief of Staff and topic owners
• Maintain action trackers, decision logs, and follow-up overviews for key meetings, ensuring visibility of owners, commitments, and deadlines
• Organize town halls, workshops, customer visits, and offsites, including scheduling and preparation of meeting materials
• Coordinate domestic and international business travel, including arrangements and logistics
• Support onboarding and recruitment activities, including interview scheduling and candidate coordination in collaboration with hiring managers and internal business partners
• Drive continuous improvement of administrative processes, document management, and overall ways of working to enhance efficiency and effectiveness Your skills and experience
• Several years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a comparable role supporting senior leaders, preferably in an international environment
• Experience managing complex schedules, leadership meetings, travel arrangements, and executive-level administrative processes
• Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills with exceptional attention to detail
• High level of professionalism, discretion, reliability, and service orientation
• Ability to work independently, proactively, and in a structured manner while managing multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
• Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across functions and organizational levels
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German, both written and spoken
• Confident use of digital tools and workflows, particularly within the MS365 environment
• Start date upon agreement Location : this role will be based in Zug/Switzerland. Please note that qualified candidates need to be legally eligible for work authorization in Switzerland Employee benefits
• Mobile working is possible in agreement with management
• Mobility Allowance
• Access to employee share programs News and stories See for yourself how innovative technology can change the present. If you would like to find out more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples . Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly. Thank you for your understanding

descriptionByLocale.it:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, uniamo i mondi reali e digitali Con tecnologia, software e servizi per edifici intelligenti, trasformiamo il quotidiano per tutti. Potenziamo i nostri clienti a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di decarbonizzazione, ridurre i costi operativi e creare esperienze occupanti di livello mondiale per la loro gente. La trasformazione digitale degli edifici è un settore dinamico in rapida evoluzione, e ha bisogno di più di una semplice grande tecnologia - ha bisogno anche di grandi persone. Sappiamo che un'impresa prospera solo se la sua gente sta prosperando, quindi a Siemens mettiamo la nostra gente prima. Come Assistente Esecutivo, supporterete il Responsabile dei Prodotti Edili e il Responsabile delle Finanze, Prodotti Edili . Building Products è un'unità globale all'interno di Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings focalizzata sullo sviluppo di tecnologie costruttive innovative, software e soluzioni digitali che aiutano i clienti a creare edifici più sostenibili, efficienti e intelligenti. In questo ruolo altamente visibile, servirai come partner affidabile per entrambi i leader e svolgerai un ruolo importante nel garantire il regolare funzionamento quotidiano dell'organizzazione. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con colleghi e partner commerciali attraverso funzioni e geografie, aiutando a coordinare le priorità, facilitare la comunicazione e sostenere le attività aziendali chiave in un ambiente dinamico internazionale. Il nostro team vi sosterrà attraverso la vostra carriera e vi sfiderà a crescere in modi nuovi ed eccitanti, come trasformiamo l’infrastruttura del mondo. Il nostro viaggio condiviso potrebbe portarti da qualche parte... dove vorresti andare? Le nuove responsabilità
• Fornire supporto amministrativo e organizzativo ad alto livello proattivo al Capo dei Prodotti Edili e al Capo delle Finanze, Prodotti Edili, in un ambiente dinamico internazionale
• Agire come punto di contatto affidabile e facilitare il flusso efficace di comunicazione e informazioni tra il capo dei prodotti edili, il capo delle finanze, il capo del personale, il team di leadership, la rete di assistenti e altri stakeholder chiave
• Aiuta a proteggere l'attenzione della leadership e l'efficacia anticipando proattivamente i conflitti del calendario, evidenziando gli scontri prioritari e garantendo tempi di preparazione adeguati per discussioni critiche e forum decisionali
• Gestire la corrispondenza confidenziale e le comunicazioni in inglese e tedesco con il più alto livello di professionalità e discrezione
• Gestire agende complesse, riunioni di leadership e priorità in più fusi orari. Assicurarsi che gli ordini del giorno, i pre-read, i materiali e gli elenchi dei partecipanti siano raccolti, coordinati e distribuiti in tempo, in stretta collaborazione con il Capo di Stato Maggiore e con i proprietari di argomenti
• Mantenere tracciatori d'azione, registri delle decisioni e guide di follow-up per incontri chiave, garantendo visibilità dei proprietari, impegni e scadenze
• Organizzare sale comunali, workshop, visite ai clienti e offsite, tra cui la pianificazione e la preparazione di materiali per riunioni
• Coordinare i viaggi d'affari nazionali e internazionali, compresi gli accordi e la logistica
• Sostegno alle attività di bordo e di reclutamento, tra cui la programmazione delle interviste e il coordinamento dei candidati in collaborazione con i dirigenti di assunzione e i partner aziendali interni
• Migliorare continuamente i processi amministrativi, la gestione dei documenti e le modalità di lavoro globali per migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia Le tue competenze ed esperienza
• Diversi anni di esperienza come assistente esecutivo o in un ruolo paragonabile che sostiene i leader senior, preferibilmente in un ambiente internazionale
• Esperienza gestione di complessi programmi, riunioni di leadership, accordi di viaggio e processi amministrativi a livello esecutivo
• Forte capacità organizzative, di pianificazione e di coordinamento con eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli
• Alto livello di professionalità, discrezione, affidabilità e orientamento al servizio
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, proattivo e strutturato, gestendo contemporaneamente più priorità e scadenze
• Forte collaborazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di costruire relazioni di lavoro efficaci tra funzioni e livelli organizzativi
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e fluidità in inglese e tedesco, sia scritto che parlato
• Utilizzo sicuro di strumenti e flussi di lavoro digitali, in particolare nell'ambiente MS365
• Data di inizio dell'accordo Luogo: questo ruolo si baserà in Zug/Svizzera. Si prega di notare che i candidati qualificati devono essere legalmente idonei per l'autorizzazione al lavoro in Svizzera
• Il lavoro mobile è possibile in accordo con la gestione

Grazie per la vostra comprensione

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden verbinden wir die reale und digitale Welt Mit Technologie, Software und Services für intelligente Gebäude verwandeln wir den Alltag für alle. Wir befähigen unsere Kunden, ihre Dekarbonisierungsziele zu erreichen, ihre Betriebskosten zu senken und erstklassige Insassenerlebnisse für ihre Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Die digitale Transformation von Gebäuden ist ein sich schnell verändernder, dynamischer Sektor, und er braucht mehr als nur großartige Technologie - er braucht auch großartige Menschen. Wir wissen, dass ein Unternehmen nur dann gedeiht, wenn seine Mitarbeiter florieren, also haben wir bei Siemens unsere Mitarbeiter an die erste Stelle gesetzt. Als Executive Assistant unterstützen Sie den Head of Building Products und den Head of Finance, Building Products. Building Products ist eine globale Einheit innerhalb von Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings, die sich auf die Entwicklung innovativer Gebäudetechnologien, Software und digitaler Lösungen konzentriert, die Kunden dabei helfen, nachhaltigere, effizientere und intelligentere Gebäude zu schaffen. In dieser sehr sichtbaren Rolle werden Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner für beide Führungskräfte dienen und eine wichtige Rolle bei der Sicherstellung des reibungslosen täglichen Betriebs der Organisation spielen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kollegen und Geschäftspartnern über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zusammen und helfen, Prioritäten zu koordinieren, die Kommunikation zu erleichtern und wichtige Geschäftsaktivitäten in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld zu unterstützen. Unser Team wird Sie während Ihrer Karriere unterstützen und Sie herausfordern, auf neue und aufregende Weise zu wachsen, während wir die Infrastruktur der Welt verändern. Unsere gemeinsame Reise könnte dich überall hinbringen ... wohin würdest du gerne gehen? Ihre neuen Aufgaben
• Proaktive administrative und organisatorische Unterstützung auf hoher Ebene für den Head of Building Products und den Head of Finance, Building Products, in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld
• Als vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner fungieren und einen effektiven Kommunikations- und Informationsfluss zwischen dem Leiter Bauprodukte, dem Leiter Finanzen, dem Stabschef, dem Führungsteam, dem Assistentennetzwerk und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern ermöglichen

• Umgang mit vertraulicher Korrespondenz und Kommunikation in Englisch und Deutsch mit höchster Professionalität und Diskretion
• Verwalten Sie komplexe Agenden, Führungstreffen und Prioritäten in mehreren Zeitzonen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Agenden, Vorlesungen, Materialien und Teilnehmerlisten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Stabschef und den Themenbesitzern rechtzeitig gesammelt, koordiniert und verteilt werden
• Pflegen Sie Aktions-Tracker, Entscheidungsprotokolle und Follow-up-Übersichten für wichtige Meetings, um die Sichtbarkeit von Eigentümern, Verpflichtungen und Fristen zu gewährleisten

• Förderung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Verwaltungsprozesse, des Dokumentenmanagements und der allgemeinen Arbeitsweise zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Effektivität Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

Nous habilitons nos clients à atteindre leurs objectifs de décarbonisation, à réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation et à créer des expériences d'occupant de classe mondiale pour leur peuple. La transformation numérique des bâtiments est un secteur dynamique et en évolution rapide, qui a besoin de plus que d'une grande technologie. Nous savons qu'une entreprise ne prospère que si ses gens prospèrent, donc chez Siemens nous mettons nos gens en premier. En tant qu'adjoint exécutif, vous soutiendrez le chef des produits de construction et le chef des finances, des produits de construction. Building Products est une unité mondiale au sein de Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings axée sur le développement de technologies de construction innovantes, de logiciels et de solutions numériques qui aident les clients à créer des bâtiments plus durables, efficaces et intelligents. Dans ce rôle très visible, vous servirez de partenaire de confiance aux deux dirigeants et jouerez un rôle important pour assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'organisation. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec vos collègues et vos partenaires commerciaux à l'échelle des fonctions et des géographies, contribuant ainsi à coordonner les priorités, à faciliter la communication et à soutenir les activités commerciales clés dans un environnement international dynamique. descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply as a service technician today: in building control systems and start immediately or by appointment – your team is looking forward to you! No CV at hand? No problem! Alternatively, you can start your application with us via WhatsApp and contact us directly and easily. Your new tasks
• Independent and team-wide processing of demanding projects in the field of building control systems as well as OT infrastructure projects
• Technical and timing project responsibility
• Project planning and implementation
• Coordination of cooperation with our customers: the internal team and the external stakeholders
• Customer support: Inside and execution in the project and life cycle business
• Area of operation: Zurich Region
• Willingness to serve your talents and experiences
• Training level (HF/FH) in electrical engineering, computer science, building technology or equivalent
• Experience in building automation is mandatory
• Contact points in the environment of building control systems such as Desigo CC are advantageous
• Sound know-how in the network area is a plus
• Microsoft operating system knowledge (client/server) is desirable
• Office 365 skills
• We presuppose: self-employment, reliability, organizational talent and the joy of learning something new
• Very good knowledge of German, ideally good knowledge of English Your advantages
• Your own electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Diverse training opportunities
• Access to employee stock plans
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! “Siemens is one of the pioneers of technology, and being part of it makes me kind of proud.” (Team Leader at Siemens) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. Diana Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens – How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds Smart infrastructure intelligently connects energy systems, buildings, and industries to evolve and improve the way we live and work. We focus on all types of buildings in a wide variety of markets. Always with the aim of continuously improving infrastructures. We do this regardless of the size of the building, through networked, cloud-based digital offerings and services, as well as through products, components, and systems. From intelligent power grid control, building automation and management systems, fire protection and security solutions to switches, valves, and sensors. Siemens – for the sustainable development of our world of tomorrow. Shape the future with us as part of a global team of around 320,000 employees. As an intern, you are an important part of #TeamSiemens. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland and beyond? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the role of “ Internship Energy Management in Building Automation ”. Your new responsibilities
• Support in the field test of an optimization algorithm for Building Energy Management on a real building. We contribute to the energy transition by aligning the operation of hot water tanks and batteries with the grid needs. To this end, we exploit PV excess and variable tariffs. Our approach is Rule-based MPC.
• Analysis of the potential for improvement
• Further development of the optimizer using an existing simulation environment Your talents and experiences
• You are currently enrolled at a Swiss university or university of applied sciences (or are taking a break between studies) in the field of electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, MIBS, or MEST
• Good knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink
• Reliable, independent way of working
• Good command of German and/or English
• Start date by agreement for a minimum of six months Employee benefits
• Opportunity to develop an international professional network
• Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
• Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members What it’s like working for us We place significant emphasis on fostering an inclusive and flexible working culture that encourages everyone to be their authentic selves. Equal opportunities and diversity are important to us and contribute to an enriching corporate culture. We actively embrace mobile working to provide every colleague with more autonomy and the chance to achieve a good work-life balance.
