descriptionByLocale.it:
#TomorrowWithUs Vuoi contribuire a plasmare il futuro del mondo ferroviario insieme a noi? In Siemens Mobility siamo il fornitore leader della mobilità e in costante espansione il nostro portafoglio innovativo, che comprende veicoli ferroviari, automazione ferroviaria, soluzioni di elettrificazione, sistemi ferroviari completi e servizi di accompagnamento. Con circa 800 dipendenti specializzati in Svizzera e 39 600 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, formiamo la mobilità con passione e siamo un passo avanti rispetto al nostro tempo. Formare il futuro della tecnologia di controllo e di sicurezza. Unisci il pensiero strategico con l'eccellenza tecnica e capisci come ispirare le persone per obiettivi comuni. Con il vostro spirito innovativo, il vostro potere decisionale e la vostra capacità di guidare con successo i team interdisciplinari, state attivamente guidando la trasformazione delle tecnologie di segnale classico verso soluzioni scalabili e digitali. I tuoi compiti
• Si guida e sviluppa un dipartimento con circa 20 dipendenti in termini di tecnico, organizzativo e personale.
• Sei responsabile della pianificazione strategica e del controllo dei progetti di sviluppo nel campo delle caselle di segnale e RBC con un focus sulle architetture di piattaforma, ambienti di sviluppo moderni, automazione e scalabilità.
• Garantisci la riuscita realizzazione di progetti complessi in termini di qualità, costi e scadenze.
• Svilupperai attivamente la roadmap tecnologica e fornirai impulsi per soluzioni innovative e all'avanguardia.
• Promuovere lo sviluppo continuo dei processi di sviluppo e migliorare l'efficienza e la standardizzazione.
• Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo, la gestione dei prodotti e altre aree specializzate per sfruttare le sinergie e integrare i nuovi requisiti di mercato nello sviluppo dei prodotti in una fase iniziale.
• Garantisci il rispetto delle elevate esigenze di un ambiente di sviluppo critico per la sicurezza. Il tuo profilo
• Studi tecnici universitari completi (master) in elettronica, ingegneria del software, ingegneria meccanica o un campo di studio comparabile.
• Ulteriore formazione in amministrazione aziendale o una solida comprensione delle relazioni commerciali.
• Diversi anni di esperienza di leadership nella gestione di team di sviluppo o di progetto, idealmente nell'ambiente di sistemi tecnici complessi o applicazioni critiche alla sicurezza e a livello di direttore di reparto
• Esperienza nello sviluppo di piattaforme, architetture di sistema o soluzioni tecniche integrate.
• Forte comprensione dei processi di sviluppo moderni, dell'automazione e dei paesaggi di sistema e software scalabili.
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura
• una cultura di lavoro aperta e flessibile in una delle aziende leader nel campo della mobilità in Svizzera
• una settimana di 40 ore su un costo del 100%
• almeno 5 settimane di vacanze
• un posto di lavoro al polso della tecnologia ferroviaria
• Vari vantaggi e opportunità di formazione dei dipendenti
• un modello di lavoro ibrido: bilanciamento della vita lavorativa e maggiore autonomia Il nostro team e la posizione Vuoi informazioni sulla nostra cultura, i nostri valori, la diversità e altri argomenti importanti? descriptionByLocale.en:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Want to help shape the future of the railway world together with us? At Siemens Mobility, we are the leading provider of mobility and are constantly expanding our innovative portfolio, which includes rail vehicles, rail automation, electrification solutions, complete rail systems and accompanying services. With around 800 specialist employees in Switzerland and 39 600 employees worldwide, we shape mobility with passion and are one step ahead of our time. Shape the future of control and safety technology. You combine strategic thinking with technical excellence and understand how to inspire people for common goals. With your innovative spirit, your decision-making power and your ability to successfully lead interdisciplinary teams, you are actively driving the transformation of classical signalling technologies towards scalable, digital platform solutions. Your tasks
• You lead and develop a department with around 20 employees in terms of technical, organizational and personnel.
• You are responsible for the strategic planning and control of development projects in the field of signal boxes and RBC with a focus on platform architectures, modern development environments, automation and scalability.
• You ensure the successful implementation of complex projects in terms of quality, costs and deadlines.
• You will actively develop the technological roadmap and provide impulses for innovative and forward-looking solutions.
• You promote the continuous development of development processes and drive efficiency improvements and standardization.
• You will work closely with development, product management and other specialist areas to exploit synergies and integrate new market requirements into product development at an early stage.
• You ensure compliance with the high demands of a safety-critical development environment. Your profile
• Completed university technical studies (master) in electronics, software engineering, mechanical engineering or a comparable field of study.
• Further training in business administration or a sound understanding of business relations.
• Several years of leadership experience in the management of development or project teams, ideally in the environment of complex technical systems or safety-critical applications and at department manager level
• Experience in the development of platforms, system architectures or integrated technical solutions.
• Strong understanding of modern development processes, automation and scalable software and system landscapes.
• Very good German and English skills in word and writing You benefit from
• an open and flexible working culture at one of the leading companies in the field of mobility in Switzerland
• a 40-hour week on a 100% fee
• at least 5 weeks of holidays
• a workplace at the pulse of railway technology
• Various employee benefits and training opportunities
• a hybrid working model: balanced work-life balance and more autonomy Our team and location You want information about our culture, our values, diversity and other important topics? Find out why Siemens is voted one of the most popular employers in Switzerland every year and get an insight into your new working environment today: Siemens Mobility CV Siemens Mobility as an employer Video Siemens Mobility Interested? Apply today with your CV online on our application platform (button "COMPETITION"). We accept applications exclusively through our application platform. For this position, only direct applications are considered. Answers to the most common questions and a contact form can be found at siemens.ch/contact-hr. We look forward to your full application. Information for staff agents

• Expérience dans le développement de plateformes, d'architectures de systèmes ou de solutions techniques intégrées.
• Une bonne compréhension des processus modernes de développement, de l'automatisation et des paysages de logiciels et de systèmes évolutives.
• Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais en paroles et en écriture

jobs.description:
Nous relions les mondes réels et numériques en collaboration avec nos clients. Siemens Digital Industries est un leader en innovation et technologie pour l'automatisation industrielle et la digitalisation. Avec un portefeuille de produits complet et des solutions système pour l'automatisation, nous relions le monde virtuel au monde réel, rendant ainsi la vie et le travail plus simples, plus rapides et plus efficaces. Notre équipe OEM-Sales recherche une collègue ou un collègue motivé(e), ayant le goût du contact client direct et des connaissances en commande numérique pour machines-outils CNC, de préférence SINUMERIK. Vous élaborez des solutions pour nos clients, les constructeurs de machines romands, pour une mise en œuvre réussie d'un système de commande CNC. Pour cela, vous utilisez également les technologies les plus récentes, par exemple le jumeau numérique (Digital Twin). En collaboration avec une équipe à forte expertise technique, vous développez de nouvelles approches techniques, modèles d'affaires et sources de valeur ajoutée pour l'industrie suisse des machines-outils. Avez-vous suivi une formation technique et déjà acquis de l'expérience professionnelle dans un environnement industriel ? Êtes-vous passionné(e) par la technique et par l'élaboration de solutions innovantes et digitalisées avec nos clients et partenaires, et êtes-vous curieux(se) d'explorer de nouvelles voies ? SINUMERIK n'a-t-il pas de secret pour vous ? Si vous ne remplissez pas tous les critères mais que vous êtes motivé(e) et audacieux(se), n'hésitez pas à postuler. Notre équipe se réjouira de vous accueillir dans notre environnement ! Vos nouvelles tâches
• Vous êtes responsable du support technique client et de la promotion des solutions système auprès des fabricants de machines-outils de Suisse romande
• Vous développez ainsi des concepts de solutions sur mesure dans le domaine de l'automatisation pour machines-outils et vous élaborez des feuilles de route pour leur mise en œuvre
• Par ailleurs, vous participez à l'élaboration de concepts et de modèles d'affaires avant-gardistes autour de la machine-outil, et vous soutenez et vous accompagnez nos clients dans leur transformation numérique
• De plus, vous accompagnez nos clients sur des questions techniques et les soutenez ponctuellement lors de la mise en service de machines et de leurs accessoires Vos talents et votre expérience
• Vous disposez d'une formation dans le domaine de l'électronique ou de la mécanique, de préférence avec un focus sur la commande/programmation de machines-outils, ou d’un diplôme HES/ES en construction mécanique, technique d'automatisation, mécatronique ou domaine similaire
• Vous possédez de solides connaissances techniques dans le domaine de la commande des machines-outils, tant en tant qu'utilisateur que dans la mise en service, et vous avez idéalement déjà une expérience avec SINUMERIK et SINAMICS
• Vous vous distinguez par une personnalité communicative et engageante, et vous convainquez les clients de manière autonome et proactive grâce à votre initiative, vos compétences techniques et votre présentation professionnelle, afin de mener les projets à bien
• Vous portez un véritable enthousiasme pour la technique de commande et d'entraînement, les outils de conception et de simulation (NX, MCD, Process Simulate), ainsi que les applications Edge et Cloud Computing
• Votre langue maternelle est le français. Pour le contact avec les clients et équipes locaux et internationaux, vous disposez de bonnes connaissances en allemand et en anglais Vo s avantages
• Abonnement de transports publics à prix réduit et stationnement gratuit
• Nombreuses opportunités de développement et de formation continue
• Accès aux plans d’actionnariat pour les membres du personnel
• Retrouve z tous les avantages ic i Notre culture d’entreprise – votre nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est bien plus qu’un simple environnement de travail : elle est au cœur de notre collaboration quotidienne et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail tourné vers l’avenir, faisant la part belle à l’innovation, au développement durable et à l’épanouissement personnel. Nous nous distinguons par notre responsabilité individuelle, l’égalité des chances et la diversité, qui permettent à chaque collaborateur et collaboratrice de s’investir de manière authentique. Nous mettons en œuvre des modèles de travail flexibles et le travail mobile afin de permettre à notre personnel de trouver un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Retrouve z plus d’info rmations et découvre z avec notre quiz culture si vous conv enez à Siemens !  « Siemens fait partie des pionniers de la technologie et je suis fière d’écrire son histoire avec elle . » (Cheffe d’équipe chez Siemens) Actualités et stories Découvre z par vous -même à quel point les innovations technologiques peuvent déjà transformer notre vie. Questions fréquentes et vo tre interlocuteur ou interlocutrice Vous trouver ez ici une synthèse des questions fréquemment posées ainsi que la possibilité de nous contacter directement. J’attends votre candidature avec impatience ! Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Willst du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Bahnwelt mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Mobility sind der führende Anbieter im Bereich der Mobilität und erweitern ständig unser innovatives Portfolio, das Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierung, Elektrifizierungslösungen, komplette Bahnsysteme und begleitende Dienstleistungen umfasst. Mit rund 800 Fachmitarbeitenden in der Schweiz und 39 600 Mitarbeitenden weltweit gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind unserer Zeit einen Schritt voraus. Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer IT und industriellen Steuerungssystemen und stellst sicher, dass die von uns freigegebenen Systeme und Infrastrukturlandschaften leistungsfähig, sicher und zukunftsgerichtet ausgerichtet sind. Dazu übernimmst du auch die Verantwortung für unser umfangreiches Testlabor. Wenn du eine echte Leidenschaft für Hardware mitbringst, gerne selbstständig arbeitest und Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Deine neuen Aufgaben
• Evaluierung und Freigabe von COTS-Hardware: Du bist unser Profi, wenn es darum geht, Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Hardware zu evaluieren, zu testen und für unsere OT-Infrastrukturen freizugeben. Deine Entscheidungen sichern die Basis unserer Systeme!
• Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb von OT-Infrastrukturen (Labor): Dazu gehören insbesondere Serversysteme, Virtualisierungsumgebungen und Industrial IoT-Komponenten, die du mit deinem Hardware-Wissen optimierst.
• Installation und Patchmanagement von Betriebssystemen: Du kümmerst dich um die Installation, Konfiguration und Wartung von Betriebssystemen wie Windows und Linux auf unserer OT-Hardware, um eine reibungslose Funktion zu gewährleisten.
• Planen und Umsetzen von OT-Architekturen unter Berücksichtigung von Sicherheits-, Verfügbarkeits- und Compliance-Anforderungen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering- und IT-Teams zur Integration von Systemen und Anwendungen
• Analyse von bestehenden OT-Umgebungen sowie Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
• Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Cybersecurity-Massnahmen im OT-Umfeld (z. B. Netzwerksegmentierung, Zero-Trust-Ansätze)

• Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Unterstützung im Incident- und Problemmanagement Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im relevanten Umfeld gepaart mit solider Berufserfahrung
• Fundierte Erfahrung im Umfeld OT, Industrie-IT, Automatisierung oder Produktionsinfrastrukturen
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Hardware-Evaluierung und -Integration sowie in Betriebssystemen wie Windows und Linux.

• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise gepaart mit einem hohen Qualitätsanspruch
• Kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht zu vermitteln
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Du profitierst von

• mindestens 5 Wochen Ferien

descriptionByLocale.it:
#TomorrowWithUs Vuoi contribuire a plasmare il futuro del mondo ferroviario insieme a noi? In Siemens Mobility siamo il fornitore leader della mobilità e in costante espansione il nostro portafoglio innovativo, che comprende veicoli ferroviari, automazione ferroviaria, soluzioni di elettrificazione, sistemi ferroviari completi e servizi di accompagnamento. Con circa 800 dipendenti specializzati in Svizzera e 39 600 dipendenti in tutto il mondo, formiamo la mobilità con passione e siamo un passo avanti rispetto al nostro tempo. Si muove all'interfaccia tra sistemi informatici classici e sistemi di controllo industriale e assicurarsi che i sistemi e i paesaggi infrastrutturali approvati da noi siano efficienti, sicuri e orientati al futuro. Si assume anche la responsabilità per il nostro ampio laboratorio di test. Se avete una vera passione per l'hardware, come lavorare indipendentemente e assumersi la responsabilità, allora siete al posto giusto con noi! Le nuove attività
• Valutazione e approvazione dell'hardware COTS: Lei è nostro esperto quando si tratta di valutare, testare e rilasciare hardware commerciale off-the-shelf (COTS) per le nostre infrastrutture OT. Le vostre decisioni assicurano la base dei nostri sistemi!
• Progettazione, sviluppo e funzionamento delle infrastrutture OT (laboratorio): Questo include sistemi server, ambienti di virtualizzazione e componenti IoT industriali, che si ottimizzano con la vostra conoscenza hardware.
• Installazione e gestione delle patch dei sistemi operativi: si prende cura dell'installazione, della configurazione e della manutenzione di sistemi operativi come Windows e Linux sul nostro hardware OT per garantire un funzionamento regolare.
• Pianificare e implementare architetture OT tenendo conto dei requisiti di sicurezza, disponibilità e conformità
• Chiudi la collaborazione con team di ingegneria e IT per integrare sistemi e applicazioni
• Analisi degli ambienti OT esistenti e identificazione del potenziale di ottimizzazione
• Attuazione e ulteriore sviluppo delle misure di sicurezza informatica nell'ambiente OT (ad esempio segmentazione di rete, approcci zero-trust)
• Gestione di partner e fornitori esterni e partecipazione a progetti in tutto il ciclo di vita
• Creazione di documentazione tecnica e supporto nella gestione degli incidenti e dei problemi
• Studi completi in informatica, ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia di automazione o formazione professionale completa nell'ambiente pertinente accoppiato con solida esperienza professionale
• Esperienza sonora nel settore delle infrastrutture OT, IT industriali, automazione o produzione
• Conoscenza approfondita della valutazione e dell'integrazione hardware e sistemi operativi come Windows e Linux.
• L'esperienza nell'attuazione dei concetti di sicurezza informatica nell'ambiente OT è vantaggiosa

descriptionByLocale.en:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Want to help shape the future of the railway world together with us? At Siemens Mobility, we are the leading provider of mobility and are constantly expanding our innovative portfolio, which includes rail vehicles, rail automation, electrification solutions, complete rail systems and accompanying services. With around 800 specialist employees in Switzerland and 39 600 employees worldwide, we shape mobility with passion and are one step ahead of our time. You move at the interface between classical IT and industrial control systems and ensure that the systems and infrastructure landscapes approved by us are efficient, secure and future-oriented. You also take responsibility for our extensive test laboratory. If you have a real passion for hardware, like working independently and taking on responsibility, then you are at the right place with us! Your new tasks
• Evaluation and approval of COTS hardware: You are our expert when it comes to evaluating, testing and releasing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) hardware for our OT infrastructures. Your decisions secure the basis of our systems!
• Design, development and operation of OT infrastructures (laboratory): This includes server systems, virtualization environments and industrial IoT components, which you optimize with your hardware knowledge.
• Installation and patch management of operating systems: You take care of the installation, configuration and maintenance of operating systems such as Windows and Linux on our OT hardware to ensure smooth operation.
• Planning and implementing OT architectures taking into account security, availability and compliance requirements
• Close collaboration with engineering and IT teams to integrate systems and applications
• Analysis of existing OT environments and identification of optimization potential
• Implementation and further development of cybersecurity measures in the OT environment (e.g. network segmentation, zero-trust approaches)
• Management of external partners and suppliers as well as participation in projects across the entire lifecycle
• Creating technical documentation and support in incident and problem management Your profile
• Completed studies in computer science, electrical engineering, automation technology or completed vocational training in the relevant environment coupled with solid professional experience
• Sound experience in the field of OT, industrial IT, automation or production infrastructures
• In-depth knowledge of hardware evaluation and integration as well as operating systems such as Windows and Linux.
• Experience in the implementation of cybersecurity concepts in the OT environment is advantageous
• Analytical and structured working method paired with a high quality standard
• Communicative personality with the ability to convey complex issues appropriately
• Very good German and English skills You benefit from
• an open and flexible working culture at one of the leading companies in the field of mobility in Switzerland
• a 40-hour week on a 100% fee
• at least 5 weeks of holidays
• a workplace at the pulse of railway technology
• Various employee benefits and training opportunities
• a hybrid working model: balanced work-life balance and more autonomy Our team and location You want information about our culture, our values, diversity and other important topics? Find out why Siemens is voted one of the most popular employers in Switzerland every year and get an insight into your new working environment today: Siemens Mobility CV Siemens Mobility as an employer Video Siemens Mobility Interested? Apply today with your CV online on our application platform (button "COMPETITION"). We accept applications exclusively through our application platform. For this position, only direct applications are considered. Answers to the most common questions and a contact form can be found at siemens.ch/contact-hr. We look forward to your full application. Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens does not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Willst du gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Bahnwelt mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Mobility sind der führende Anbieter im Bereich der Mobilität und erweitern ständig unser innovatives Portfolio, das Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierung, Elektrifizierungslösungen, komplette Bahnsysteme und begleitende Dienstleistungen umfasst. Mit rund 800 Fachmitarbeitenden in der Schweiz und 39 600 Mitarbeitenden weltweit gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind unserer Zeit einen Schritt voraus. Du bewegst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer IT und industriellen Steuerungssystemen und stellst sicher, dass die von uns freigegebenen Systeme und Infrastrukturlandschaften leistungsfähig, sicher und zukunftsgerichtet ausgerichtet sind. Dazu übernimmst du auch die Verantwortung für unser umfangreiches Testlabor. Wenn du eine echte Leidenschaft für Hardware mitbringst, gerne selbstständig arbeitest und Verantwortung übernimmst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Deine neuen Aufgaben
• Evaluierung und Freigabe von COTS-Hardware: Du bist unser Profi, wenn es darum geht, Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Hardware zu evaluieren, zu testen und für unsere OT-Infrastrukturen freizugeben. Deine Entscheidungen sichern die Basis unserer Systeme!
• Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und Betrieb von OT-Infrastrukturen (Labor): Dazu gehören insbesondere Serversysteme, Virtualisierungsumgebungen und Industrial IoT-Komponenten, die du mit deinem Hardware-Wissen optimierst.

• Planen und Umsetzen von OT-Architekturen unter Berücksichtigung von Sicherheits-, Verfügbarkeits- und Compliance-Anforderungen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering- und IT-Teams zur Integration von Systemen und Anwendungen
• Analyse von bestehenden OT-Umgebungen sowie Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
• Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von Cybersecurity-Massnahmen im OT-Umfeld (z. B. Netzwerksegmentierung, Zero-Trust-Ansätze)
• Steuerung externer Partner und Lieferanten sowie Mitwirkung in Projekten über den gesamten Lifecycle hinweg
• Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Unterstützung im Incident- und Problemmanagement Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im relevanten Umfeld gepaart mit solider Berufserfahrung
• Fundierte Erfahrung im Umfeld OT, Industrie-IT, Automatisierung oder Produktionsinfrastrukturen
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Hardware-Evaluierung und -Integration sowie in Betriebssystemen wie Windows und Linux.
• Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Cybersecurity-Konzepten im OT-Umfeld von Vorteil

• Kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte adressatengerecht zu vermitteln

• Son expérience dans le domaine des infrastructures OT, IT industrielle, automatisation ou production
• Connaissance approfondie de l'évaluation et de l'intégration du matériel ainsi que des systèmes d'exploitation tels que Windows et Linux.

• Personnalité communicative capable de transmettre des questions complexes de manière appropriée
• Très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais Vous bénéficiez de
• une culture du travail ouverte et flexible dans l'une des plus grandes entreprises du domaine de la mobilité en Suisse
• une semaine de 40 heures avec des frais de 100 %
• au moins 5 semaines de vacances
• un lieu de travail au rythme de la technologie ferroviaire

Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen verbinden wir die reale und die digitale Welt. Als eines der führenden Technologieunternehmen beschäftigt Siemens in der Schweiz rund 6000 Mitarbeitende. • Erstellung, Kalkulation und Anpassung von Offerten inklusive Verhandlung, Nachverfolgung und Kundenkommunikation

• Du bist eine Persönlichkeit, die sich auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen einstellen kann
• Du bist bereit, dich ständig weiterzuentwickeln und auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik und Branchenentwicklungen zu bleiben
• Gute Office-Skills werden vorausgesetzt, zusätzliche Kenntnisse in SAP wären wünschenswert
• Sehr gute Deutsch- und (vorteilhafterweise) Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab Deine Vorteile
• 2–3 Tage/Woche mobiles Arbeiten ist Standard
• Vergünstigtes ÖV-Abo und Gratisparkplätze
• Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
• Alle Vorteile findest du hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur – dein neues Arbeitsumfeld Die Kultur bei Siemens Schweiz ist mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld – sie ist das Herzstück unseres täglichen Miteinanders und der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, das von Innovation, Nachhaltigkeit und persönlicher Entfaltung geprägt ist. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobiles Arbeiten sind bei uns gelebte Realität und ermöglichen unseren Mitarbeitenden eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Erfahre mehr und entdecke mit unserem Kulturquiz , ob du zu Siemens passt! «Siemens gehört zu den Pionieren der Technologie, und Teil davon zu sein, macht mich schon irgendwie stolz.» (Teamleiterin bei Siemens) News und Stories Verschaffe dir selbst einen Eindruck davon, wie innovativ Technologie unsere Gegenwart verändern kann. Häufig gestellte Fragen und deine Ansprechperson Hier findest du eine Sammlung häufig gestellter Fragen sowie die Möglichkeit, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Ich freue mich auf deine Bewerbung. Vielen Dank für das Verständnis.

• Supporti la vendita di nuovi progetti e le offerte associate nella regione di Berna
• Discutere le esigenze con i clienti e creare soluzioni personalizzate

• Diverse opportunità di formazione

• Potete trovare tutti i vantaggi qui La nostra cultura aziendale – il tuo nuovo ambiente di lavoro La cultura della Siemens Svizzera è più che un semplice ambiente di lavoro: è al centro della nostra collaborazione quotidiana e della chiave del nostro successo. Siemens Svizzera offre un ambiente di lavoro orientato al futuro caratterizzato da innovazione, sostenibilità e sviluppo personale. Siamo caratterizzati da responsabilità personale, pari opportunità e diversità, in cui ogni dipendente può contribuire in modo autentico. I modelli di lavoro flessibili e il lavoro mobile sono una realtà per noi e permettono ai nostri dipendenti di raggiungere un equilibrio equilibrato della vita lavorativa. Scopri di più e scopri con il nostro quiz culturale se sei adatto per Siemens! “Siemens è uno dei pionieri della tecnologia, ed essere parte di esso mi rende un po 'orgogliosa.” (Team Leader presso Siemens) Notizie e Storie Scopri come la tecnologia innovativa può cambiare il nostro presente. Se volete saperne di più su quali progetti possono essere implementati utilizzando la tecnologia Siemens, ecco alcuni esempi attuali. Domande frequenti e la persona di contatto Qui troverete una raccolta di domande frequenti e la possibilità di contattarci direttamente. Non vedo l'ora della sua candidatura. Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply in the office today and start from July – your team in Ostermundigen is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• Creation, calculation and adaptation of offers including negotiation, tracking and customer communication
• You support the sale of new projects and the associated offers in the Berne region
• Discuss needs with customers and create customized solutions
• You independently maintain the data in the offer and in the CRM tool Your talents and experiences
• Technical or business training completed
• Ideally, you have experience in fire alarm systems
• Affinity to IT topics and digital process solutions
• You have good communication skills and proactively shape cooperation in the team
• You are a personality that can adapt to different target groups
• You are ready to constantly develop and stay on top of the latest technology and industry developments
• Good office skills are assumed, additional knowledge in SAP would be desirable
• Very good German and (advantageous) English skills round off your profile
• 2–3 days/week mobile work is standard
• Discounted ÖV subscription and free parking
• Diverse training opportunities
• Access to employee stock plans
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! “Siemens is one of the pioneers of technology, and being part of it makes me kind of proud.” (Team Leader at Siemens) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as a sales assistant for our team in Volketswil. Your new tasks
• You are responsible for processing offers/submissions and projects for fire detection and evacuation systems
• In addition, you calculate, create and monitor offers and tenders in cooperation with the field service.
• The development of concepts as well as technical solutions is also part of this
• Preparation of customer orders for execution
• With your broad knowledge, you advise both the field service and the customer: inside in all technical aspects
• Project processing with CRM Salesforce, sales/planning tools
• Plan-/Schemastellung in AutoCAD round off your tasks Your talents and experiences
• You bring a successfully completed technical training
• Several years of technical and/or sales experience in fire protection and evacuation are highly desired
• Business administration or technical training are advantageous
• The joy of digitalization distinguishes you
• Experience with CRM, sales/planning tools are desirable
• As a communicative and team-capable personality with a focus on customers: inside you achieve quality in your work
• Good knowledge of German, every other language benefits your advantages
• 2–3 days/week mobile work is standard
• Discounted ÖV subscription and free parking
• Diverse training opportunities
• Access to employee stock plans
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! “Siemens is one of the pioneers of technology, and being part of it makes me kind of proud.” (Team Leader at Siemens) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. Roman Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we Hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

Apply today in Team Service Sales and start from August - your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks

• Based on this, you conduct sales negotiations, advise existing and new customers comprehensively and accompany the process until the successful conclusion of the contract.
• In addition, you will support campaigns and market actions, conduct customized workshops and act as the central point of contact for digital service services.
• Finally, you collect and maintain relevant data in the offer and customer management tool and provide a complete offer documentation ensure your talents and experiences.
• Successfully completed technical training, preferably in the field of electrical or IT

• Experience in developing individual solution concepts and strong analytical skills
• You convince with an authentic appearance, communication and negotiating strength as well as a pronounced customer and service orientation
• Very good German and good English skills Your advantages
• 6 weeks holiday

• Infrastrutture IT, reti e sistemi di comunicazione, ambienti server Windows, virtualizzazione, sistemi OT, tecnologia ferroviaria, sicurezza informatica, operazioni di servizio
• Conoscenza della gestione degli incidenti, della gestione dei problemi, dell'analisi delle cause della radice, della gestione delle vulnerabilità, della gestione delle patch e della gestione degli asset.
• Esperienza nella preparazione della documentazione tecnica e un metodo di lavoro strutturato e metodico.
• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese
• competenze di pensiero analitico, alto orientamento del cliente e del servizio, nonché il piacere di risolvere le sfide tecniche indipendentemente.
• Prontezza per la notte e il servizio di chiamata. Lei beneficia di

• una settimana di 40 ore su un costo del 100%

descriptionByLocale.en:
Create a better #TomorrowWithUs Want to help shape the future of the railway world together with us? At Siemens Mobility, we are the leading provider of mobility and are constantly expanding our innovative portfolio, which includes rail vehicles, rail automation, electrification solutions, complete rail systems and accompanying services. With around 800 specialist employees in Switzerland and 39 600 employees worldwide, we shape mobility with passion and are one step ahead of our time. Service Engineer IT/OT & Cybersecurity Services 100% You move at the interface of IT, Operational Technology (OT) and Cybersecurity and ensure that our systems are operated safely, stable and reliable in the railway environment. In this versatile role, you combine technical expertise with service responsibility, work closely with customers, engineering and project teams, and make an important contribution to the availability and security of critical infrastructures. Your tasks
• You will ensure the reliable operation of our IT/OT systems and service platforms, analyze technical failures based on monitoring, log and operational data and develop sustainable solutions to ensure high service quality.
• You support the service organization in technical special topics, escalations as well as maintenance and service operations and assume technical responsibility in demanding operating situations.
• You will perform vulnerability analysis and assessments, support vulnerability and risk management, coordinate patch management measures and contribute to compliance with cybersecurity and compliance requirements in security-critical environments.
• You are responsible for the technical traceability of systems, maintain asset and lifecycle information and support obsolescence and modernization topics.
• You’ll analyze the root cause of disruptions, create technical reports and recommendations, maintain a structured knowledge base and contribute to the continuous improvement of services, processes and standards.
• You accompany service projects from planning to handover to operation, work closely with project managers, engineering teams and external partners and support customer presentations and technical reviews. Your profile
• Completed training or study in computer science, systems engineering, electrical engineering, automation, communications technology or a comparable technical discipline.
• Several years of experience in several of the following areas:
• IT infrastructures, networks and communication systems, Windows server environments, virtualization, OT systems, railway technology, cybersecurity, service operations
• Knowledge of incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, vulnerability management, patch management and asset management.
• Experience in the preparation of technical documentation as well as a structured and methodical working method.
• Very good knowledge of German and English
• Analytical thinking skills, high customer and service orientation as well as pleasure in solving technical challenges independently.
• Readiness for night and on-call duty. You benefit from
• an open and flexible working culture at one of the leading companies in the field of mobility in Switzerland
• a 40-hour week on a 100% fee
• at least 5 weeks of holidays
• a workplace at the pulse of railway technology
• Various employee benefits and training opportunities
• a hybrid working model: balanced work-life balance and more autonomy Our team and location You want information about our culture, our values, diversity and other important topics? Find out why Siemens is voted one of the most popular employers in Switzerland every year and get an insight into your new working environment today: Siemens Mobility CV Siemens Mobility as an employer Video Siemens Mobility Interested? Apply today with your CV online on our application platform (button "COMPETITION"). We accept applications exclusively through our application platform. For this position, only direct applications are considered. Answers to the most common questions and a contact form can be found at siemens.ch/contact-hr. We look forward to your full application. Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens does not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

Créer un meilleur #DemainWithUs Vous voulez aider à façonner l'avenir du monde ferroviaire avec nous ? Chez Siemens Mobility, nous sommes le premier fournisseur de mobilité et nous développons constamment notre portefeuille innovant, qui comprend des véhicules ferroviaires, l'automatisation ferroviaire, des solutions d'électrification, des systèmes ferroviaires complets et des services d'accompagnement. Avec environ 800 employés spécialisés en Suisse et 39 600 employés dans le monde, nous façonnons la mobilité avec passion et sommes à un pas de notre temps. Ingénieur de service IT/OT & Cybersecurity Services 100% Vous déménagez à l'interface des TI, de la technologie opérationnelle (OT) et de la cybersecurity et vous assurez que nos systèmes sont exploités en toute sécurité, stable et fiable dans l'environnement ferroviaire. Dans ce rôle polyvalent, vous combinez l'expertise technique et la responsabilité du service, travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les clients, les équipes d'ingénierie et de projet, et contribuez grandement à la disponibilité et à la sécurité des infrastructures critiques. Vos tâches
• Vous assurerez le fonctionnement fiable de nos systèmes IT/OT et de nos plateformes de service, analyserez les défaillances techniques basées sur la surveillance, le log et les données opérationnelles et développerez des solutions durables pour assurer une qualité de service élevée.
• Vous soutenez l'organisme de service dans des sujets techniques spéciaux, des escalades ainsi que des opérations de maintenance et de service et assumez la responsabilité technique dans des situations d'exploitation exigeantes.
• Vous effectuerez des analyses et des évaluations de vulnérabilité, supporterez la gestion de la vulnérabilité et des risques, coordonnerez les mesures de gestion des patchs et contribuerez au respect des exigences en matière de cybersécurité et de conformité dans les environnements critiques pour la sécurité.
• Vous êtes responsable de la traçabilité technique des systèmes, de maintenir l'information sur les actifs et le cycle de vie et de soutenir l'obsolescence et les sujets de modernisation.
• Vous analyserez les causes profondes des perturbations, créerez des rapports et des recommandations techniques, conserverez une base de connaissances structurée et contribuerez à l'amélioration continue des services, des processus et des normes.
• Vous accompagnez les projets de service de la planification au transfert à l'exploitation, travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet, les équipes d'ingénierie et les partenaires externes et soutenez des présentations et des avis techniques. Votre profil
• Formation ou études en informatique, en génie des systèmes, en génie électrique, en automatisation, en technologie des communications ou dans une discipline technique comparable.
• Plusieurs années d'expérience dans plusieurs des domaines suivants:
• Infrastructures informatiques, réseaux et systèmes de communication, environnements serveurs Windows, virtualisation, systèmes OT, technologie ferroviaire, cybersécurité, opérations de service
• Connaissance de la gestion des incidents, de la gestion des problèmes, de l'analyse des causes profondes, de la gestion de la vulnérabilité, de la gestion des patchs et de la gestion des biens.
• Expérience dans la préparation de la documentation technique ainsi qu'une méthode de travail structurée et méthodique.
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais
• Aptitudes à la réflexion analytique, grande orientation client et service ainsi que plaisir à résoudre les défis techniques indépendamment.
• Préparation pour la nuit et le service de garde. Vous bénéficiez de
• une culture du travail ouverte et flexible dans l'une des plus grandes entreprises du domaine de la mobilité en Suisse
• une semaine de 40 heures avec des frais de 100 %
• au moins 5 semaines de vacances
• un lieu de travail au rythme de la technologie ferroviaire

jobs.description:
Insieme ai nostri clienti, colleghiamo il mondo reale e quello digitale. Come una delle principali aziende tecnologiche, Siemens impiega circa 6.000 persone in Svizzera. Con le nostre soluzioni pionieristiche nei settori della tecnologia edilizia, dell'energia, della mobilità, della salute e dell'industria, stiamo plasmando il futuro. Vuoi anche contribuire attivamente al ritmo dei tempi e migliorare la vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora sei nel posto giusto! Candidati oggi come C apo Progetto Sistemi di Sicurezza e inizia subito o su appuntamento – il tuo team non vede l'ora di incontrarti! I tuoi nuovi compiti
• Elaborazione indipendente di progetti impegnativi e complessi nel campo dei sistemi di sicurezza
• Sarai responsabile della gestione tecnica, finanziaria e della programmazione del progetto
• Assunzione della pianificazione operativa e organizzazione delle risorse materiali
• Coordinerai anche la collaborazione con i clienti e le varie persone di contatto
• Supporta il team di vendita con aggiustamenti di preventivi e programmi di manutenzione
• Sviluppo di processi e casi d'uso come parte della fase concettuale ed esecuzione, nonché traduzione nell'architettura della soluzione
• Come specialista, sarai in grado di guidare la gestione dei processi e dei cambiamenti durante tutto il ciclo del progetto I tuoi talenti ed esperienza
• Hai un apprendistato specializzato in ambito elettrico (elettricista, informatica, tecnico di automazione)
• Esperienza come project manager e conoscenza nel campo dei sistemi di sicurezza (controllo accessi, videosorveglianza e sistemi di allarme per intrusioni)
• Esperienza in IT e tecnologia di rete desiderabile
• Hai forti capacità analitiche ed esperienza nello sviluppo di concetti di soluzioni individuali
• Competenze di negoziazione, affidabilità e modo indipendente di lavorare
• Buona conoscenza del tedesco sia oralmente che per iscritto, la conoscenza orale dell'inglese è un vantaggio
• Luogo di residenza nel canton Ticino I tuoi benefici
• 2-3 giorni a settimana lavoro mobile come standard globale
• La tua auto elettrica (che puoi usare anche privatamente)
• Ulteriori opportunità di formazione sia per il tuo sviluppo professionale che personale
• Accesso ai piani azionari per dipendenti
• Puoi trovare tutti i benefici qui La nostra cultura aziendale – il tuo nuovo ambiente di lavoro La cultura di Siemens Svizzera è più di un semplice ambiente di lavoro: è il cuore della nostra collaborazione quotidiana e la chiave del nostro successo. Siemens Svizzera offre un ambiente di lavoro orientato al futuro, caratterizzato da innovazione, sostenibilità e sviluppo personale. Ci distinguiamo per l'autonomia, le pari opportunità e la diversità, in cui ogni dipendente può contribuire in modo autentico. Modelli di lavoro flessibili e lavoro mobile sono una realtà vissuta da noi e consentono ai nostri dipendenti un equilibrato equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata. Scopri di più e verifica con il nostro quiz sulla cultura se sei adatto a Siemens! «Siemens è uno dei pionieri della tecnologia, e farne parte mi rende in qualche modo orgogliosa.» (Capo team presso Siemens) Notizie e Storie Fatti un'idea di come la tecnologia innovativa possa cambiare il nostro presente. Se vuoi saperne di più su quali progetti possono essere realizzati con la tecnologia Siemens, qui troverai alcuni esempi attuali. Domande frequenti e il tuo referente Qui troverai una raccolta di domande frequenti e la possibilità di contattarci direttamente . Non vedo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura. Roman Talent Acquisition Partner Il tuo percorso verso Siemens – Come assumiamo Informazioni per le agenzie di collocamento: Siemens Svizzera non accetta candidature da agenzie di collocamento per questa posizione. Grazie per la comprensione.

• You have an electrically specialized apprenticeship (electricist, computer science, automation technician)

• Experience in IT and desirable network technology
• You have strong analytical skills and experience in developing concepts of individual solutions
• Trading skills, reliability and independent way of working
• Good knowledge of German both orally and in writing, oral knowledge of English is an advantage
• Place of residence in canton Ticino Your benefits

• Your electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Further training opportunities for both your professional and personal development
• Access to employee share plans

We stand out for autonomy, equal opportunities and diversity, in which each employee can contribute authentically. descriptionByLocale.en:
Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. As a service technician, you have the opportunity to be your own boss and can enjoy a lot of freedom when planning your customer assignments. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as a service technician: in fire alarm systems and start from 01.09.2026 – your team is looking forward to you! No CV at hand? No problem! With us you can start your application via WhatsApp and contact us directly and easily. Your new tasks
• Independent maintenance, inspection and maintenance of fire alarm systems at our customers: inside
• Analysis and correction of malfunctions and repairs to modern fire detection systems
• Commissioning, extension and retrofitting of fire alarm and peripheral equipment
• Technical advice and support for our customers: on site
• Implementation of system tests and support for administrative and acceptance controls
• Documentation of the work carried out in our digital service tools
• Ensuring system availability and compliance with relevant standards and regulations
• Pikettdienst assignments and support of your colleagues: your talents and experiences in challenging technical challenges
• Completed technical training, for example as an electrical installer:in, automatic operator:in or a comparable qualification
• In-depth experience in the service, maintenance or maintenance of technical facilities
• Good IT user knowledge and interest in modern digital work equipment
• Ideally, experience with fire alarm systems or other safety systems as well as knowledge of the relevant VKF guidelines and standards
• Analytical and solution-oriented thinking as well as enjoyment of direct customer contact
• Very good knowledge of German in word and writing, knowledge of English is an advantage
• Your own electric car (which you can also use privately)
• Independent, flexible work and freedom in operational planning
• Many development opportunities
• Paid training
• You can find all the advantages here Our corporate culture - your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Find out more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you fit Siemens! For me, customer impact means supporting our customers with tailor-made solutions – so that their everyday life becomes simpler, more efficient and more reliable. » (Project Management Office Professional) News and Stories Get a sense of how innovative technology can change our present. If you want to learn more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples. Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. Melanie Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens Switzerland does not accept recruitment applications for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
Nous relions les mondes réels et numériques en collaboration avec nos clients Siemens est un leader technologique qui emploie environ 6000 personnes. Technique du bâtiment, énergie, mobilité, santé et industrie : nos solutions innovantes portent sur de nombreux domaines et façonnent le monde de demain. Vous aimeriez vous aussi contribuer aux prochaines innovations et améliorer la vie de millions de personnes en Suisse ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous! Déposez votre candidature dès aujourd’hui en tant que Technicien·ne de service en détection incendie pour la région Vaud Ouest et commence dès que possible – votre équipe se réjouisse de vous accueillir. Vos nouvelles tâches
• Mise en service, modernisation et extension des installations de détection d’incendie
• Service après-vente : réalisation des maintenances dans les délais et entretien des installations
• Dépannage des systèmes, contrôles divers, révisions annuelles et petites offres complémentaires
• Conseiller et accompagner la clientèle
• Participation régulière au service de piquet
• Respect des directives de qualité et de sécurité au travail
• Votre domicile se situe idéalement dans la région de Lausanne / Rolle Vos talents et votre expérience
• CFC d’électricien·ne, électromécanicien·ne, automaticien·ne ou équivalent
• Autonome et doté·e d’un bon sens relationnel avec la clientèle et les collègues
• Expérience professionnelle, de préférence dans le domaine du bâtiment et du service après-vente
• Apte à travailler seul·e et à s’organiser de manière indépendante avec un bon esprit d’équipe
• Attaché·e à la qualité avec une démarche orientée client·e·s et résultats
• Très bonne maîtrise du français ; la connaissance de l’allemand est un plus Vos avantages
• Votre propre voiture électrique (que vous pourrez également utiliser à titre privé)
• Travail indépendant et flexible, et liberté de planifier vos interventions
• Nombreuses opportunités de développement et de formation continue
• Formations continues rémunérées
• Retrouve tous les avantages ici Notre culture d’entreprise – votre nouvel environnement de travail La culture de Siemens Suisse est bien plus qu’un simple environnement de travail : elle est au cœur de notre collaboration quotidienne et la clé de notre succès. Siemens Suisse offre un environnement de travail tourné vers l’avenir, faisant la part belle à l’innovation, au développement durable et à l’épanouissement personnel. Nous nous distinguons par notre responsabilité individuelle, l’égalité des chances et la diversité, qui permettent à chaque collaborateur et collaboratrice de s’investir de manière authentique. Nous mettons en œuvre des modèles de travail flexibles et le travail mobile afin de permettre à notre personnel de trouver un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée. Retrouvez plus d’info rmations et découvrez avec notre quiz culture si vous convenez à Siemens !  « Siemens fait partie des pionniers de la technologie et je suis fière d’écrire son histoire avec elle. » (Cheffe d’équipe chez Siemens) Actualités et stories Découvrez par vous-même à quel point les innovations technologiques peuvent déjà transformer notre vie. Si vous voulez en savoir plus sur les projets qui peuvent être mis en œuvre à l’aide de la technologie Siemens, vous trouverez ici quelques exemples a ctuels . Questions fréquentes et votre interlocuteur ou interlocutrice Vous trouverez ici une synthèse des questions fréquemment posées ainsi que la possibilité de nous contacter directement. J’attends votre candidature avec impatience ! Sven Talent Acquisition Partner Information concernant le placement de personnel : pour ce poste, Siemens Suisse n’accepte pas les candidatures issues du placement de personnel. Merci de votre compréhension .

jobs.description:
Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works. The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure. Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go? As a student trainee, intern or trainee, you are an important part of #TeamSiemens. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of AI Infrastructure Intern – Deployment and Maintenance and start from 26.08.2026 – your team is looking forward to meeting you! You will be working in a team that is doing cutting-edge research in Industrial AI. Your tasks would involve deploying and maintaining AI agents on AWS and Edge devices. Typically, you enjoy setting up and configuring cloud services or like to experiment with distributed systems architecture. Ideally you would be a "hands-on" person who is willing to explore and learn on demand. Your new responsibilities
• You support the deployment of local large language models (LLMs) using frameworks such as Ollama, contributing to the implementation and optimisation of AI infrastructure
• Building on this, you assist in setting up and maintaining cloud-based AI services, particularly leveraging Amazon Web Services (AWS) Bedrock and related tools
• In this context, you collaborate with the team to automate infrastructure processes through scripting and ensure smooth operation of Linux-based systems
• Additionally, you contribute to documenting deployment processes and infrastructure configurations in a clear and structured manner, including the creation of diagrams Your talents and experience
• You are currently enrolled at a Swiss university in a relevant field such as computer science, engineering or data science
• You have hands-on experience with frameworks for local large language models (LLMs) such as Ollama
• You are familiar with AWS Bedrock and have a fundamental understanding of services in Amazon Web Services
• You have some practical experience with agentic artificial intelligence and scripting infrastructure setups
• You work in a structured and solution-oriented manner and communicate technical topics clearly in English Employee benefits
• Mobile working from anywhere within Switzerland
• Opportunity to develop an international professional network
• Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
• Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz ! Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly. I look forward to receiving your application. Nathalie Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens is not accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

Mit unseren wegweisenden Lösungen in den Bereichen Gebäudetechnik, Energie, Mobilität, Gesundheit und Industrie gestalten wir die Zukunft. Willst auch du aktiv am Puls der Zeit mitwirken und das Leben von Millionen von Menschen in der Schweiz besser machen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bewirb dich noch heute als Technische:r Zeichner:in Security – dein Team freut sich auf dich! Deine neuen Aufgaben
• Verantwortung für die Modellerstellung und Zeichnung: Du erstellst und bearbeitest projektbezogene Schemata und Lagepläne für Security-Systeme (Zutritt, Video, Einbruch) in AutoCAD, Revit oder BIM-Tools.
• Digitaler Vorreiter: Du nutzt moderne BIM-Hilfsmittel und -Methonden und trägst aktiv zur Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung der Prozesse und der Zusammenarbeit durch digitale Werkzeuge bei.
• Fachliche Prüfung und Qualität: Du hinterfragst Projektanforderungen kritisch, hältst interne und vom Verband vorgegebene Richtlinien und Vorgaben strikt ein und sicherst die Genauigkeit deiner Unterlagen vor der Freigabe.
• Schnittstellenfunktion: Du unterstützt bei Bedarf den Vertrieb und die Ausführung bei technischen Fragestellungen und fungierst als Bindeglied zu Projektleitern, Technikern und unseren GBS-Partnern (Offshoring).
• Effizienz im Fokus: Du optimierst deine eigene Auftragslast, stellst eine lückenlose und konsistente Dokumentation sicher und sorgst dafür, dass kein übermässiger Backlog entsteht. Deine Talente und Erfahrungen
• Fundierte Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Elektrozeichner:in oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik/Gebäudetechnik.
• Software-Profi: Du beherrschst AutoCAD und Revit sicher. Zudem bist du versiert im Umgang mit dem MS-Office-Paket.
• Normen-Know-how: Du bringst Kenntnisse der relevanten Normen und Vorschriften (z. B. SES-Verband) mit.
• Persönlichkeit: Du bist eine kundenorientierte, kontaktfreudige und motivierte Persönlichkeit, die gerne Eigeninitiative zeigt und vorausschauend denkt.
• Selbstmanagement: Du setzt Prioritäten geschickt, behältst auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick über Fristen und verwaltest deine Zeit effektiv.
• Arbeitsstil: Du bist ein:e verlässliche:r Teamplayer:in, arbeitest äusserst präzise und überzeugst durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative.
• Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst stilsicher in Deutsch und verfügst über gute Kenntnisse in Englisch, Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Deine Vorteile
• 2–3 Tage/Woche mobiles Arbeiten ist Standard
• Vergünstigtes ÖV-Abo und Gratisparkplätze
• Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
• Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
• Alle Vorteile findest du hier Unsere Unternehmenskultur - dein neues Arbeitsumfeld Die Kultur bei Siemens Schweiz ist mehr als nur ein Arbeitsumfeld – sie ist das Herzstück unseres täglichen Miteinanders und der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Siemens Schweiz bietet ein zukunftsorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld, das von Innovation, Nachhaltigkeit und persönlicher Entfaltung geprägt ist. Wir zeichnen uns durch Eigenverantwortung, Chancengerechtigkeit und Vielfalt aus, in der sich jede:r Mitarbeitende authentisch einbringen kann. Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und mobiles Arbeiten sind bei uns gelebte Realität und ermöglichen unseren Mitarbeitenden eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. Erfahre mehr und entdecke mit unserem Kulturquiz , ob du zu Siemens passt! «Siemens steht für Qualität, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit! Mit diesen Werten kann ich mich voll identifizieren.» (Process Manager) News und Stories Verschaffe dir selbst einen Eindruck davon, wie innovativ Technologie unsere Gegenwart verändern kann. Wenn du mehr dazu erfahren willst, was für Projekte mittels Siemens Technologie umgesetzt werden können, findest du hier einige aktuelle Beispiele . Häufig gestellte Fragen und deine Ansprechperson Hier findest du eine Sammlung häufig gestellter Fragen sowie die Möglichkeit, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Ich freue mich auf deine Bewerbung. titleByLocale.it: Techniker:in/ Ingegnere Betriebsoptimierung & Energieeffizienz 80-100%
titleByLocale.fr: Techniker:in/ Ingénieur Betriebsoptimierung & Energieeffizienz 80-100%

jobs.description:
Gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen verbinden wir die reale und die digitale Welt. Als eines der führenden Technologieunternehmen beschäftigt Siemens in der Schweiz rund 6000 Mitarbeitende. Mit unseren wegweisenden Lösungen in den Bereichen Gebäudetechnik, Energie, Mobilität, Gesundheit und Industrie gestalten wir die Zukunft. Sustainability Services – Unterstützung für energetische Betriebsoptimierung:  Bist Du davon überzeugt, dass wir mit Innovation und Leidenschaft nicht nur die Gebäude und Anlagen unserer Kund:innen verbessern, sondern vielmehr einen nachhaltig positiven Beitrag für unsere Umwelt leisten können? Unser unterstützender Teamgeist, ein offener und ehrlicher Austausch und die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kund:innen führen uns zum Erfolg.  Wir setzen neueste und zukunftsweisende Technologien ein, um die Leistungsfähigkeit der Gebäude und Anlagen stetig zu verbessern. Damit senken wir nicht nur Kosten für unsere Kund:innen, sondern schützen aktiv unsere Umwelt. Bewirb Dich noch heute als Techniker:in/ Engineer Betriebsoptimierung & Energieeffizienz, begleite uns auf diesem erfolgreichen Weg und entfalte Dich als wichtigen Teil in unserem Team, das Du bevorzugt vom Standort Root, alternativ Zürich oder Volketswil aus unterstützt. Wir freuens uns auf Dich! Deine neuen Aufgaben
• Analyse und Optimierung von HLKS-Anlagen zur Reduzierung von Energieverbrauch und CO2-Emissionen
• Durchführung von energetischen Betriebsoptimierungen direkt vor Ort bei unseren Kundinnen und Kunden

jobs.description:
We transform buildings With technology for smart and sustainable buildings and infrastructure, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and achieve world-class experiences for people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first. Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure We are seeking an Incident & Vulnerability Coordinator to join the Cybersecurity Business Support Team within SI B Cybersecurity Unit Location : Zug, Switzerland The Role This is a results-driven role for someone who can advance incident response and vulnerability management outcomes while serving as a bridge between technical teams and the business translating complex security information into clear, actionable language that stakeholders can act on You will own the coordination of incident response and vulnerability management across the unit. On the incident side, that means maintaining a current and effective response plan, coordinating activities when incidents occur, and ensuring the right people have the right information at the right time. On the vulnerability side, the focus is equally important: helping internal teams understand what vulnerabilities exist, which ones matter, and what the remediation path looks like. This requires close, ongoing communication with product teams, engineering, and stakeholders so vulnerabilities are understood, prioritized, and addressed by the people responsible for fixing them This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation. You will be the connective tissue between technical teams and the business side of SI B, ensuring both sides have what they need to move forward What you'll be doing -Incident management : Own and maintain the incident response plan. Keep it current, update when needed, and ensure it functions effectively when activated -Coordination : Serve as the primary point of contact during incidents and for ongoing vulnerability management activities. Ensure the right stakeholders are engaged and informed throughout -Communication : This is a central part of the role. During incidents, keep internal stakeholders informed and aligned. For vulnerabilities, maintain ongoing communication with product and engineering teams across SI B helping them understand what has been identified, what the risk profile looks like, and what remediation involves. Act as the bridge, not a bottleneck -Reporting : Produce clear, actionable reports on incidents and vulnerability posture for internal stakeholders. Focus on insight that supports decision-making, not raw data -Process improvement : Lead the lessons-learned process after incidents and integrate findings into protocols, training, and playbooks so each iteration improves on the last -Training and awareness : Work with teams to develop and deliver training that helps people across SI B understand their role in security incidents and vulnerability handling Your Profile -Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or a related field -Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or GCIH are a plus -5–10 years of experience in incident response and vulnerability management roles -Hands-on experience with incident management platforms and vulnerability scanning tools -Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and functions -A genuine focus on enabling the business to move forward, not just enforcing policy -Fluent English, with the ability to explain complex security topics to non-technical audiences -German or additional languages are a plus Employee benefits
• 2–3 days per week of mobile working is standard
• Mobility allowance
• Varied further training opportunities
• Access to employee share programs
• Further information about employee benefits can be found here Our corporate culture – your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz ! “ I was impressed by the flexibility and values of Siemens. ” (Martin, Project Manager) News and stories See for yourself how innovative technology can change the present. If you want to find out more about what projects can be implemented using Siemens technology, here are some current examples . Frequently asked questions and contact information Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly. I look forward to receiving your application. Olger Talent Acquisition Partner Your way to Siemens - How we hire Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens is not accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.
